articleTitle: Cost Efficient Location Tracking and Health Monitoring System for Soldier Safety
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Soldiers are the cornerstone of modern warfare, which makes their security of highest priority. Therefore concerned authorities need to track a soldier’s current location along with monitoring health status when required. The basic guarding system for a soldier makes use of a global positioning system (GPS) to track the location. It continuously measures health parameters such as body temperature, heart rate, etc., and transmits these collected data to the military base by using a global system for mobile communication (GSM) modem. In this paper, we have proposed a system to provide a cost-effective solution so as to deliver accurate data with minimum delay/latency, using which the concerned authorities can mobilize a rescue operation for the soldiers.

articleTitle: Water Quality Prediction using Classification techniques on XGBoost, KNeighbors, SVC, Random Forest, AdaBoost, and GaussianNB Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: A key environmental problem that is extensively researched for academic purposes is water contamination. To understand the origins, impacts, and potential solutions to water contamination, researchers look into a variety of issues. Environmental science, chemistry, biology, engineering, and policy are essential for study of water pollution. Classifiers as proposed help create early warning systems for probable pollution events by categorising water quality based on previous and current data. These systems aid in prompt reactions to occurrences of pollution prevention or mitigation. It is essential to tackling one of the most urgent issues affecting the wellbeing of ecosystems and human communities. By training models to predict the degree of pollution or the category of pollutants based on input characteristics, machine learning classifiers can classify water contamination. This study focuses on XGBoost, KNeighbour, SVC, Random Forest, Adaboost, and GaussianNB classifiers' various classification methodologies for predicting water quality. The XGBoost classifier, which may be used for future study, emerges as the best classifier out of all of these.

articleTitle: Channel Estimation for mmWave MIMO using Deep Residual Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In a massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system based on a time division duplex (TDD), the base station (BS) must accurately estimate the channel state information (CSI) for a user terminal (UT). However, due to the dynamic nature of the channel, the length of pilot signals is constrained, and there is a finite number of orthogonal pilot signals available. To fully leverage the benefits of spatial diversity and multiplexing gains in massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems, it is essential to have precise downlink channel state information (CSI) at the base station (BS). By employing minimum mean square error (MMSE) channel estimation, it becomes possible to mitigate the impact of pilot contamination in a massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system. This is achieved by utilizing the fully known covariance matrix of channels for all user terminals (UTs) that share the same pilot signal. The paper explores the combined use of MMSE and NMSE channel estimation techniques in conjunction with a Convolution encoder for channel matrix prediction. Several existing methods either suffer from overfitting or exhibit complexity similar to the zero forcing algorithm. To address these challenges, the paper introduces a three-layer residual block that effectively mitigates overfitting and efficiently handles large datasets. Additionally, the paper proposes two residual models that effectively handle dataset size variations.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Ocean Cleanup: Detecting and Classifying Marine Litter with Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Ocean ecosystems and animals are in danger from the globalization of marine litter. In the context of this environmental catastrophe, it provides a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based solution to Internet of Things (IoT)-based marine litter identification and categorization. It uses underwater cameras and sensors to capture a comprehensive database of marine waste floating in the ocean. Our suggested CNN architecture targets real-time identification and categorization of common marine trash such as plastic bottles, bags, and fishing nets. It uses transfer learning and substantial data augmentation approaches to train and fine-tune the model, resulting in impressive detection and classification accuracy. To deploy our system in harsh and far-flung maritime conditions, use a scalable and energy-efficient IoT infrastructure. Extensive testing in the field proves the viability and efficacy of the IoT-based strategy for tracking and reducing marine waste. To help politicians and environmentalists make informed choices about ocean cleaning initiatives, the technology delivers useful data in real-time via detection and classification. Leveraging the potential of IoT and deep learning technology can help in the continuing efforts to protect and preserve the seas.

articleTitle: Coconut Tree Detection in Coastal Areas with Fast-RCNN Using Resnet-50
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Remote sensing and image processing are crucial in analyzing and enhancing satellite and aerial imagery data to extract valuable information and improve its quality across various applications. In particular, the coconut tree holds significant economic and ecological importance for many tropical developing countries. Detecting coconut trees in coastal areas is a valuable research endeavor, enabling efficient administration and monitoring of coconut plantations. However, manual detection is impractical and time-consuming. To address this, we propose a Fast-RCNN-based object detection algorithm, incorporating machine learning techniques, to achieve precise coconut tree detection in coastal areas using remote sensing data. To tackle the segmentation task, we utilize the Fast R-CNN model with ResNet50 architectures. Multiple experiments were conducted, varying configuration parameters to determine the most effective settings, ensuring a detection confidence level exceeding 90%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction: An Unified Similarity-Based Neural Network Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Drug-drug interactions (DDIs) pose significant challenges in the field of pharmaceutical research and clinical practice. Accurate prediction of potential DDIs is crucial to ensure patient safety and optimize treatment outcomes. In this study, an improved approach to enhance DDI prediction using a neural network framework (named as DDI-USNN) integrated with drug similarity measures has been developed. The proposed approach leverages comprehensive datasets containing drug pairs and their interaction labels to develop a robust predictive model. By incorporating drug similarity into the neural network architecture, the proposed approach captures subtle yet vital patterns underlying DDIs. The performance measures have been evaluated in terms of precision, recall and F-measure. Traditional classifiers commonly used for drug-drug prediction, including support vector machines (SVM), neural network based (NDD), adaptive boosting (AB), and gradient boosting decision tree (GBDT), were considered to compare the performance of proposed method by considering various datasets. Through meticulous experimentation and rigorous cross-validation, the simulation results unequivocally established the superior performance of the proposed integrated similarity-based neural network when compared to conventional methods and standalone neural networks. Notably, the DDI-USNN model achieved a substantial improvement in precision, outperforming AB by 32.7%, GBDT by 26.6%, NDD by 7%, and SVM by 5.5%. Furthermore, the recall values of each method were compared with the proposed DDI-USNN, revealing a marginal decrement of 1.6% in the recall value for DDI-USNN when compared to NDD. Additionally, the mean F-measure for the proposed DDI-USNN was computed and compared with existing methods, further underscoring its effectiveness in drug-drug interaction prediction.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Protocols and Models for Improving Energy Efficiency and Security in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Green cloud computing is a current hot issue that is altering how people view data centers. Green Cloud Computing is a method for maximizing the use of computing resources. Users of cloud computing can modify their resource utilization in accordance with their demands. By enabling users to access resources from any location at any time, cloud computing has completely transformed the IT industry as a whole. Numerous data centers have been built as a result of the rising demand for cloud computing. These data centers are made up of various resource types, each with a different power usage pattern. Two major problem with cloud data centers is their high-power usage and security. Virtual machine migration and load balancing are just two of the issues that have been addressed via the development of numerous strategies and practices. This review papers will discuss problems and protocols for energy consumption, also several security models will be reviewed for cloud computing.

articleTitle: Calligraphy Font Recognition Algorithm based on Improved DenseNet network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The role of calligraphy fonts in Chinese character calligraphy is very important, but there is a problem that the font cannot be determined. The traditional DenseNet network cannot solve the problem of inaccurate calligraphy font recognition in Chinese character calligraphy, moreover. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved DenseNet network for accurate calligraphy font analysis. Firstly, the computer is used to identify and analyze the font, and the index is divided according to the requirements of the calligraphy font to reduce the calligraphy font in the interfering factor. Then, the computer recognizes the results of the Chinese character calligraphy font, forms the calligraphy font scheme, and conducts the calligraphy font result Comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that the calligraphy font of DenseNet network for Chinese character calligraphy is improved under certain evaluation criteria The recognition accuracy and calligraphy font recognition time are better than those of the traditional DenseNet network.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Improved Watchdog Timer for Memory Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: A watchdog timer is a type of electrical timer that detects and recovers from computer errors. In embedded systems and other computer-controlled equipment where individuals are unable to immediately access the equipment or react to faults in a timely way, watchdog timers are often employed. Limiting the amount of CPU time accessible to untrusted programmes in a sandbox can assist avoid denial-of-service attacks. The computer automatically refreshes the watchdog timer during normal operation avoid the timeout. The timeout signal is used to stop a programme from running indicate whether or not a corrective action should be taken. The architecture and design of an improved adjustable windowed watchdog timer for memory applications are described. The watchdog has several defect detection algorithms built in, this makes it more durable. In terms of capabilities and operations, it may be used to monitor any real-time processor-based system. architecture may be modified to a variety of situations may be readily tailored to different applications while keeping the overall system cost low, and owing to the processor reliance the recommended watchdog has less time limitations than the present watchdog. The simulation results are used to investigate the effectiveness of the proposed watchdog timer in detecting and responding to errors. Verilog is used to code the design. Xilinx Vivado 20.1 was used to implement the design. By injecting flaws into the programme while the processor is running, the design is evaluated in real-time hardware.

abstract: Cloud storage benefits both individuals and organisations by making it simpler to properly share their data over the internet. This simplifies the process of transferring data. articleTitle: Enhancing Network Performance in LEO Satellite Networks through DRL-Based Routing Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Routing in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite networks is complex due to the constantly changing network topology, unpredictable channel conditions, and the need for high QoS. This paper puts forth an innovative routing algorithm that leverages deep reinforcement learning to tackle the challenge. The algorithm considers the available network resources, traffic demand, and QoS requirements to make dynamic and efficient routing decisions. We represent the network topology as a graph and use a deep Q-learning network (DQN) to learn the optimal routing policy. The DQN is trained offline using a dataset of simulated network scenarios and then deployed online to make routing decisions based on real-time network conditions. The algorithm employs a reward function that considers network performance metrics such as delay, packet loss, and throughput to guide the learning process. To assess the effectiveness of the suggested algorithm, we carried out simulations utilizing the ns-3 network simulator. The outcomes reveal that the proposed algorithm surpasses present routing algorithms concerning network performance metrics and QoS requirements. Additionally, the algorithm exhibits robustness to network conditions and traffic demand changes.

articleTitle: Oil and Gas Reservoir Characterization in Predicting Missing Velocity Logs Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Interpreting well-logging data is crucial in the oil and gas industry as it helps make decisions on drilling, completion, and production processes. Traditional methods of interpretation are time-consuming and require specialized knowledge and experience. Over the past few years, machine learning techniques have emerged as a viable alternative to conventional interpretation methods. This research proposes a hybrid ML model that combines the strengths of different algorithms for predicting missing velocity log data in the gas and oil industry. The model is trained and tested on a large dataset from several oil fields and evaluated using multiple metrics. The proposed model effectively predicts porosity, permeability, and water saturation from well logs, outperforming traditional methods in terms of accuracy and computational efficiency. After evaluating two different proposals for predicting well-logging data, it was determined that the Ensemble Machines approach was more effective than the neural network approach. However, during testing, the neural network suffered from parameter limitations, which resulted in processing and time consumption issues. Despite these challenges, the neural network still exhibited significant potential and demonstrated excellent generalization capabilities. It highlights the promise of neural networks in predicting well-logging data, while also underscoring the importance of carefully considering processing limitations and parameter optimization in their implementation. During analysis, the ensemble model gives the highest accuracy (i.e., 82.64%) for predicting missing velocity logs.

articleTitle: Gender and Cultural Diversity in Workspace - A Significant Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Diversity in the workplace refers to the differences among employees, including cultural diversity, gender equality, and workspace equality. It's becoming increasingly important for organizations to recognize the benefits of a diverse workforce. Embracing diversity is not only ethically correct but also advantageous for organizational success. Several methods are being used by organizations to handle the diverse work environment which includes policies and rules for employees. Such policies are to be unbiased and for that employees related data need to be analyzed crucially. Data analysis empowers organizations to efficiently manage, explore and visualize data. This is where the role of data visualization tools, such as Tableau, becomes pivotal. Renowned for its usage in data analytics, Tableau serves as a cost-efficient software solution. This review paper showcases data analysis for diverse work environment in organizations, aiding in identifying patterns within the ‘Real-World Fake Data’ dataset.

articleTitle: Count Based Analysis of PCOM Using Blob-Based Detection Method in 2D Ultrasound Images of Ovary
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: This study employs image analysis techniques to investigate and quantify follicles within ovarian tissue. Two primary methods are applied: Blob Analysis and Contour Segmentation. Blob Analysis is utilized to count the number of follicles present in the ovarian tissue, while Contour Segmentation is employed to isolate and characterize regions of interest within the tissue, specifically focusing on follicles with a threshold greater than 0.2.In the Blob Analysis phase, the ovarian tissue images are subjected to thresholding to segment follicles from the background. The thresholding process identifies regions with pixel intensity values exceeding a defined threshold, and these regions are considered as follicles. The number of follicles is then counted to provide valuable quantitative data.Subsequently, Contour Segmentation is applied to further analyze the ovarian tissue. This technique identifies and isolates regions of interest, including follicles with intensity values surpassing the 0.2 threshold. Contour extraction is performed to delineate the boundaries of these regions, allowing for detailed characterization and measurement of follicular features. The combined use of Blob Analysis for follicle counting and Contour Segmentation for region isolation with a specific intensity threshold enhances the precision and comprehensiveness of ovarian tissue analysis. This methodology provides a robust framework for studying follicular dynamics and contributes to a deeper understanding of ovarian health and function.

articleTitle: A Comparative study on IoT based Communication Protocol for effective Implementation of LoRa
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The Long Range (LoRa) technology is one of the successful protocols for communication between IoT applications, M2M (Machine to Machine), V2V (Vehicle to Vehicle) and also with the human operated remote system management over existing technologies. This technology provides better communication between two entities with a long range and very low power consumption. The main objective of this paper is to make a seamless communication between operator and truck drivers at dumping sites using LoRa technology where operators can send messages from the control room to drivers. This paper gives an idea to provide drivers with a visual message rather than a voice command for avoiding miscommunication. Including outdoor gateway with generated ecosystem for multiple LoRa nodes i.e multiple truck drives. As compared to other standardized wireless solutions such as Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Zigbee, 3G/4G cellular network and more specifically with Narrow band IoT(Nb-IoT), etc. this research concludes with the recommendation that LoRa provides great transparency over this domain.

articleTitle: DC Rapid Charging Architecture in a Microgrid for Vehicle-To-Grid Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Microgrids potential energies can be stored in batteries of Electric Vehicles (EVs). It can used as storing surplus energy (grid to vehicle, G2V) and sending energy back to the grid (vehicle to grid, V2G) helps microgrid energy management. Putting this theory into practice requires setting up the right architecture and control strategy. This paper presents a construction for fast charging of stage 3 electric vehicles in a V2G-G2V microgrid system. A model of a microgrid test system for connecting electric vehicles includes a DC fast charging station. Simulation studies have established for V2G-G2V power transfer. Test results show that the EV battery actively manages microgrid energy by operating in his G2V V2G mode. This article reviews the current state of EV battery charging capabilities and it simplications for microgrids. Implementation and simulation of instance loading and unloading were studied using MATLAB Simulink software.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning-based Fine-tuned ResNet50 Model for Soybean Seeds Multiclass Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: A crucial aspect of modern agriculture and food security is the classification and analysis of agricultural products, particularly seeds. Soybean is a significant leguminous crop known for both its economic and nutritional worth. With the increase in soybean production, it becomes challenging to classify the seeds with the diseases. The ResNet-50 architecture is a well- known version of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) which is used in this study to offer a thorough investigation of the classification of healthy soybean seeds from the diseased seeds and naturally broken seeds. The ResNet-50 model is trained at different numbers of epochs to categorize soybean seeds using a dataset collected from Kaggle. The training and evaluation procedures were methodically carried out, with frequent checks on the model’s accuracy and loss. The study includes two significant epochs, each of which reveals different performance outcomes. The model’s training accuracy at epoch 25 was 97.85%, with a corresponding loss of 0.0825. Additionally, it was also determined that the validation accuracy and loss were at epoch 25 was 86.84% and 0.3719, respectively. The training accuracy at epoch 50 has been identified as 99.89% with a loss of 0.0154 whereas validation loss of 0.3619 was recorded along with an increase in validation accuracy to 89.56% in comparison to epoch 25. These results demonstrate that the ResNet-50 model is highly efficient for multiclass classification of soybean seeds which can be used for real time applications in agriculture sector.

articleTitle: Adoption of the Metaverse in the Healthcare Industry & Its Impacts on Humans: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR) are transformational forces in technology that have attracted global attention. These technologies have created the framework for a multitude of future developments, with applications in a variety of industries to improve user experiences. The use of virtual and augmented reality has grown in popularity, with an increasing number of organizations incorporating these cutting-edge tools to improve their products and services. The recent surge in interest towards VR and AR has culminated in the emergence of the “Metaverse” concept, which has received extensive media coverage. Leading corporations have already begun projects to build their own metaverse realms. This extensive review is dedicated to explaining the concept of the metaverse, documenting its historical growth, and emphasizing its associated benefits. Using survey data, this research tries to delve into public concerns about the metaverse, understanding its possible repercussions on mental, physical, and psychological components of human life. The analytical exploration of the study has served two purposes: to equip individuals with insights into forthcoming technological paradigms and to furnish enterprises with invaluable guidance for creating impeccably functioning metaverses.

articleTitle: Auto Braille: A Self Operatable Braille Printer For Taking Notes
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: This paper presents a simple Braille character printer for the blind, named "Auto Braille". Braille printers are generally designed and utilized either for printing in bulk or for short messages, but these printers are not suitable for taking notes and they can’t be operated by themselves. To overcome this issue, a Braille printer with a special mechanism, is developed which uses various actuators to get Braille printing done on a paper. The existing Braille printers are designed with the help of XY movement support structure with various modular punching mechanisms; the operating states are controlled with a micro controller with the help of PC based user commands. But, Auto Braille is designed for note printing purpose with the help of micro controller to attain Autonomous print control based on user (Visually Challenged) commands. This novel way of printing is not only based on operating states but also includes a simplified modular structure of XY movement support.The proposed design of Braille printer i.e., Auto Braille is validated with the support of user satisfaction and it ensures small size and wide range of operating styles having high accuracy for printing in different languages with the help of a novel design which employs a generalized keypad enabling the user to give inputs. The approach of this design maximizes the comfort, performance and reduces the manufacturing cost for the user.

articleTitle: Two Quadrants Operation of Switched Reluctance Motor and its Drive for EV Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The Switched Reluctance Motor (SRM) has become a potential option for variable-speed drive applications in Electric Vehicles (EVs), thanks to its straightforward design, toughness, high-speed operation, low manufacturing cost, and high efficiency. articleTitle: Enhancing the Accuracy of Emoji Conversion from Text using Novel Lagrangian Support Vector Machine Against Long Short-Term Memory Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: This research study aims to employ a unique method that integrates Lagrangian Support Vector Machine and Long Short-Term Memory techniques to forecast emoji conversions from text on social media platforms. The primary focus of evaluation will be the prediction model's accuracy. This research study involves two distinct groups: the novel Lagrangian Support Vector Machine and Long Short-Term Memory models. The dataset utilized in this study focuses on predicting emojis using text and was obtained from Kaggle. The dataset is openly accessible and comprises 7,476 rows of textual data. In order to facilitate thorough evaluation, the dataset has been split into a training set, comprising 5,980 rows, and a testing set, consisting of 1,496 rows. The accuracy of the prediction models was calculated with a statistical power (G power) of 80%. The experimental study involved conducting twenty iterations using the aforementioned models. This study revealed that the Novel Lagrangian Support Vector Machine achieved an accuracy of 57.68% in predicting emojis from text, while the Long Short Term Memory model achieved an accuracy of 33.33%. Conducting a statistical analysis employing an Independent Sample T-Test with a p-value of 0.001 (significantly lower than the conventional significance level of 0.05), the study conclusively established that the Novel Lagrangian Support Vector Machine outperformed the Long Short Term Memory model by a significant margin in terms of performance. The findings suggest that the Novel Lagrangian Support Vector Machine approach is successful in accurately predicting emojis from text.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Water Quality Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Water quality refers to the chemical, physical, and biological characteristics of water. Bacteriological indications of fecal contamination, free chlorine residual, pH, turbidity, and perhaps total dissolved solids are the primary water quality characteristics that must be handled in an emergency. These characteristics are based on the standards of its usage. Researchers examined the Water Quality Index (WQI) using traditional machine learning techniques. Traditional water quality assessment methods are time-consuming and expensive, and important WQ parameters namely Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) and Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD) were not considered due to some practical limitations. To overcome the drawbacks of the traditional water quality assessment methods, We used conventional machine learning and deep learning methods that can accurately predict the water quality parameters. Along with the PKWQI dataset, we worked on various water quality datasets in our project. Three models Random Forest (RF), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), and Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) were used in the water classification procedure, and the findings showed that RNN and LSTM performed the best for water quality analysis.

articleTitle: Detection of DDoS Attack using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In particular, Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks have become more sophisticated due to the internet’s rapid growth. It is essential for dependable internet services to identify and stop these attacks. This study combines the Naive Bayes and Decision Tree machine learning methods to distinguish between DDoS attacks and safe traffic. Through recursive partitioning, the Naive Bayes classification method provides interpretability whereas the Decision Tree classifier performs well for high-dimensional datasets. We suggest a technique that makes use of both techniques, and we evaluate how well it works using a large amount of data. After training on the same data, the algorithms identify attack patterns using the features capturing network properties that were extracted. Through the implementation of feature engineering and preprocessing methods, the interaction between DDOS and BENIGN patterns is highlighted, improving accuracy.

articleTitle: A Python-based Tool for the Generation of T-S Plot to Determine Water Masses in the World Ocean
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The World Ocean plays a pivotal role in regulating the Earth's temperature and sustaining life. A profound understanding of the intricate distribution of its water masses is indispensable for diverse scientific and environmental inquiries. Temperature-Salinity plots (TS plots) have conventionally served as a means to identify and characterize different water masses based on their thermohaline properties. In this study, we examined the physical characteristics of water masses across the global ocean using the temperature-salinity (T-S) diagram. To facilitate this investigation, we gathered Temperature and Salinity data from various databases such as the World Ocean Data Base, Simple Ocean Data Analysis (SODA) and more. The Python interface was used to model the T-S diagram. This Python-powered tool simplifies the creation of TS plots, streamlining the identification and analysis of water masses in the world's seas. Emphasizing user-friendliness and efficiency, this tool offers academics and oceanographers a valuable means of gaining insights into the structure and dynamics of the ocean.

articleTitle: Optimizing Brain Tumour Classification: A Fusion Approach of PCA, SVM, and Image-Based Features
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: This article highlights a novel method for improving the precision and efficacy of brain tumour classification. The proposed method combines image-based features with Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifiers. The application of preprocessing techniques ensures the consistency and quality of the data. PCA is used to reduce dimensionality while preserving informational distinctions. The RBF kernel is utilised by SVM classifiers trained separately on PCA-transformed and original image features. The classification of brain tumours is more precise when measured using standard metrics than when compared to conventional methods. A fusion strategy combines decision functions by aggregating the probability scores of each classifier, resulting in predictions that are robust and accurate. The results of the proposed model makes it easier and more accurate to diagnose brain tumours. Clinical applications of this integration of PCA and SVM classifiers with image-based features hold promise for medical image analysis.classification over existing state-of-the-art techniques.

articleTitle: Innovations in Wearable Radio Frequency Technology: Designing for Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The number of wireless gadgets made to be worn on the body has significantly increased in recent years. This is in part because wearable technology has been intruding on several facets of our lives, thanks to substantial advancements in processing, hardware design, and communication breakthroughs. For instance, more and more wearable technology is being developed to interface with our bodies and track vital signals like heart rate and blood pressure. Even with these advancements, battery technology has not kept up. In order to provide a better user experience, much effort has been made to identify novel materials and creative charging techniques. So this research work focusses on the recent advancements, designs and prototypes that are developed for application specific wearable devices.

articleTitle: Classification of Pneumonia Disease Through Deep Learning Procedures and Fine-tuning on ResNet50V2 CNN Model Utilizing Chest Xray Images
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Many different types of germs like bacteria, viruses, fungus, and other tiny organisms can make you get pneumonia. Depending on the etiological agent and the patient's health, the intensity of this disease's symptoms might vary from minor to severe. Streptococcus pneumoniae frequently causes viral pneumonia, while influenza viruses and other viruses can cause bacterial pneumonia. Improved pneumonia diagnostic techniques, therapies, and vaccinations are still being researched. In order to increase accuracy, categorization of the pneumonia sickness is done in this study utilising the ResNet50V2 Model and chest X-ray images. Using medical pictures, often chest X-rays or CT scans, pneumonia illness classification includes the application of machine learning and deep learning algorithms to automatically distinguish between healthy and pneumonia-infected individuals. In impoverished nations where access to healthcare is poor, pneumonia is a major cause of illness and mortality.

articleTitle: Design of High Gain, Low Power, Subthreshold Operation Amplifier for Different Node Technologies and Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: This paper discusses the design and comparative analysis of Low supply voltage and ultra-low power consumption-based operational amplifier. This work focuses on the design of such a two-stage operational amplifier operating in the subthreshold region. A comparative analysis has been performed on several parameters comparing the results obtained to determine the optimal design of the operational amplifier. The said amplifier has been designed in the 180nm, 45nm, 32nm, and 16nm technology processes. When simulated on a SPICE-based circuit simulator, LTSPICE, the design achieves a maximum gain of 72.44dB with a Gain bandwidth product of 72.66KHz and a phase margin of 65.62° while dissipating a power of only 97.578nW which is ideal for low-power devices and biomedical applications.

articleTitle: Implementation and Performance Analysis of a SIP Enabled Softphone System with Machine Learning Based QoS Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Softphone systems have gained immense popularity over the course of the years. One of the most important protocols used in softphones is the Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) which provides real-time communication across many devices. This paper analyses the performance of a SIP-based softphone system with real-time QoS monitoring. The system is developed in JavaScript to provide compatibility for mobile and desktop applications across web browsers. The softphone uses Asterisk as a signaling server and the frontend interface is developed using HTML5 and the SIPml5 library to enable SIP capability. To determine the quality of video calls, a Video Quality Assessment (VQA) algorithm that uses machine learning to provide a QoS score is used. The video quality assessment is performed in real time as the system is subject to different testing conditions by varying the number of parallel calls. Furthermore, metrics such as bit rate, packet loss and jitter are used to analyse the network response of the system. The analysis shows that the VQA algorithm can operate seamlessly with the SIP enabled softphone system to assess the QoS in real-time. However, the capacity of SIP to support multiple parallel calls by maintaining an acceptable QoS is limited when only one server is used.

articleTitle: Defect Dynamics in DJ Perovskite Solar Cells: Unraveling the Impact on Photovoltaic Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)

Through variations in IDDs (1X 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup> – 1X10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>), we have analysed the impact of defect density variations sandwiched between PEDOT: PSS and (BEA) FA<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> layers, as well as (BEA) FA<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> and PCBM: C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</inf> layers. articleTitle: Modeling Spline Curves for Lightweight Cryptographic Hash Function
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Parametric spline curves offer flexibility, smoothness and ability to represent complex shapes in various fields of Computer Graphics and other related fields. These mathematical curves are popularly used for interpolation or approximation purposes only. This paper claims that parametric spline curve representation can be modelled to be used for cryptographic operations or hash function protocols as it satisfies all four desirable properties of a hash function. Traditional hash function algorithms rely on the mathematical properties of certain groups, such as prime fields or elliptic curves, to securely exchange keys between parties. They are difficult to implement and require high computational power. In contrast parametric spline curve-based hash functions are easy to implement and the level of security offered by them can be scaled up or down by manipulating curve parameters.

articleTitle: An Emperical Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for Used Car Price Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The market for used cars is a dynamic and ever-expanding industry, with various factors influencing the pricing of pre-owned vehicles. Accurate pricing is crucial for both buyers and sellers, as it ensures fair transactions and minimizes the risk of financial loss. This paper introduces a machine learning algorithms developed for the purpose of predicting used car prices based on a comprehensive set of features. Various machine learning (ML) techniques such as multiple linear regression, ridge regression, lasso regression, Bayesian regression, Decision tree regression, random forest regression, eXtreme Gradient Boost (XGB) regression, Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LGBM) regression, Gradient boosting regression and Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) regression. To assess the algorithm's performance, rigorous evaluation metrics such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Squared Error (MSE), and R-squared (R2) score has been employed.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: IoT Based Radar System using Ultrasonic Sensor for Enhanced Object Detection and Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: a radar system built on the Internet of Things (IoT) that uses ultrasonic sensors to find things within 150 degrees. The system's rotation is controlled by a servo motor, and a Graphical User Interface (GUI) built using Java Swing and applets displays the results of detection. In addition, the system has a feature that, upon the observation of an object, sends notifications to a user's mobile device. The proposed system can be used to detect objects in its vicinity efficiently and effectively in a variety of scenarios, such as security surveillance and environmental monitoring. The system's hardware and software components are covered in the article along with the testing and validation processes applied to gauge the system's performance. The suggested IoT-based radar system can, in general, improve object recognition abilities and give users real-time notifications, making it a desirable complement to the current range of IoT devices.

articleTitle: Currency And Counterfeit Currency Detection Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: This project aimed to develop a solution which can assist visually impaired individuals in identifying currency denominations and detecting counterfeit currency. To achieve this, we used Teachable Machine for currency denomination detection and MATLAB for counterfeit currency detection. The resulting model was then integrated into an Android application, making it easily accessible to users. The project involved collecting and recording audio files for different currency denominations, which were then used for training the Teachable Machine model. The MATLAB model used edge detection and feature extraction techniques to detect counterfeit currency. The Android application provided an easy-to-use interface for users to detect the denomination of currency and identify its originality. By integrating these two models, we were able to achieve a solution that can be used by visually impaired individuals to easily identify currency and avoid counterfeit currency. In summary, this project presents a practical solution to address the challenges faced by visually impaired individuals in handling currency and detecting counterfeit currency.

articleTitle: An Approach to Recognize Speech Using Convolutional Neural Network for the Multilingual Language
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition Systems (ASRS) are essential for supporting natural language communication between human and machines. It has gained prominence when Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) were introduced. It allows user to naturally interact with machine and perform hands-free operation. In addition, it is a fundamental technology used in many fields such as Education, Smart Home Automation, Automotive, Aviation, Disable People and so on. In this paper, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based ASRS is built which models raw speech signals. The speech corpus targeted is our own created database in four languages like Hindi, English, Punjabi and Bengali. The recording is done in different environment by 50 male and native speakers of Hindi and Punjabi language. They were able to speak English and Bengali as well. In addition, the collected raw speech samples are further used to extract features using Mel-frequency Cepstral Coefficient (MFCC), the most widely used technique for feature extraction. Further, the 2D CNN model with 6 layers was designed to recognize the speech samples for each language. The experimental results depict the validation accuracy of 96.29% with 0.174 loss. Hence, a significant performance is demonstrated by the CNN-based model for this comprehensive tonal speech dataset.

articleTitle: Personality Prediction Using Psychometric and CV Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: A recruitment process involves many processes such as aptitude estimation, personality assessment, as well as shortlisting Curriculum Vitae of the prospective candidates which can be extensive and cumbersome. The proposed system will rank the candidates suitable for a particular job profile with respect to aptitude and personality tests taken by candidates. The system uses the OCEAN Model for gauging the primary personality traits of the candidates. Firstly, candidate CVs will be shortlisted by machine learning algorithms which target the key skills that match the description of the job profile, which is followed by ranking of the candidates most suitable for a given job description, contingent on the scores of the psychometric tests. Thus, the system achieves to provide a legally justified and fair CV ranking system.

articleTitle: Automated Energy Monitoring System for Smart grids and Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The technical advancements in modernizing the world in every way possible have increased the usage of power and energy. Due to this, an increase in tariff, decrease in power quality, and frequent blackouts have increased every day because of traditional methods used in transmission lines. The proposed methodology addresses this drawback by offering the usage of advanced energy meters in smart grids and microgrids for efficient transmission of power and energy across every household and industry, improving power quality and reducing the chance of blackouts [1] significantly. This allows both the user and the utility to continuously monitor the energy usage, power factor, power quality, and load usage in real-time, to maintain the load balance in the grid.

articleTitle: IoT Based Smart Irrigation System for Crops and Water Leakage Detection Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: This paper will provide an image-processing technique for locating a water leak in subterranean pipes. When intelligent cities started to appear, several countries began to address this problem by utilizing technologies like intelligent water networks. However, this idea seeks to contribute to the context of smart cities using less complex and non-destructive technology. This study also makes a case for replacing the pretreatment stage of image processing with deep learning or machine learning techniques. It will be shown that this feature helps emphasize interesting spots and boost contrast. Thermal images of the soil's surface collected with an underground water leak were used to test the hypothesis. These conditions were presented in a lab using a flawless sandy soil model. Three sensors—ultrasonic sensors, soil moisture sensors, and temperature sensors—that are connected to a Raspberry Pi are used in this project. The system will use the idea of image processing to collect data from the plants. Before the fertilizer provision procedure is continued, this data will be compared to the Leaf Color Chart (LCC) chart. The project aims to create an effective irrigation system based on IoT. Utilizing sensors and image processing to improve irrigation effectiveness and monitor the soil's humidity, moisture, and temperature levels year-round.

articleTitle: Review of CardioPulmonary Exercise Tests on Athletes using Sensor Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The Cardiopulmonary exercise test (CPET) is an advanced assessment method which combines the power of sensors with the human body response to physical activity. This test uses a range of sensors to provide a complete evaluation of an athlete's cardiovascular and breathing systems enabling them to determine their physical fitness, endurance, and performance capacity.CPET is an important instrument for optimizing performance and assessment of underlying pathology in a population of athletes. For determining the normal CPET result for an athletic individual it is appropriate to take account of the effects of regular, vigorous exercise on exercising physiology. This provides breath-by-breath gas exchange measures of 3 variables: O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> uptake (VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>), carbon dioxide output (VCO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>), and ventilation (VE). Analysis of CPET on athletes from various fields and situations are considered. The results of the tests conducted by different methodologies are studied.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Frequency-Selective Microstrip Patch Antenna Design for C-Band Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In this study, a reconfigurable frequency-selective microstrip antenna operating in many different frequency ranges in C-band is designed and analyzed by using High Frequency Structural Simulator (HFSS). FR4 dielectric material and copper conductive substrates are preferred in the design of the antenna with dimensions of 15 × 30 mm and thickness of 1.6 mm. In addition to that, two PIN diodes are utilized to make the microstrip antenna reconfigurable and enable it to operate in six different frequency regions (3.62−4.02 GHz, 3.78−4.96 GHz, 3.79−4.22 GHz, 4.46−8.24 GHz, 4.79−7.89 GHz, 4.92−8.09 GHz) depending on four different switching states. Due to the small and economical structure of the proposed antenna, it can be used in many different fields and applications in the C-band operating range.

articleTitle: Research on Object Detection and Segmentation Algorithm based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The role of object detection and segmentation in image processing is very important, but there is a problem that the processing results cannot meet expectations. Traditional recognition methods cannot solve the problem of object detection and segmentation in image processing, and the recognition results are not reasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes a deep learning for professional object detection and segmentation analysis. First, artificial intelligence is used to process and analyze the image, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of target detection and segmentation to reduce them Interference factors in object detection and segmentation. Then, the artificial intelligence results of object detection and segmentation in image processing to form a target detection and segmentation scheme and pair Comprehensive analysis of object detection and segmentation results. MATLAB simulation shows that under the condition of certain evaluation criteria, deep learning can detect and segment the object of image processing The rationality of object detection and segmentation is better than that of traditional recognition methods.

articleTitle: Hadoop based BIM Cloud Service Framework and Spatial Location Retrieval Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid informatization of urban architecture, BIM is based on a three-dimensional information model to share information and collaborate throughout the entire lifecycle of project initiation, planning, budgeting, design, procurement, construction, establishment, delivery management, and operation and maintenance. Establishing a Hadoop based BIM cloud service framework is the basic approach to applying BIM and the core of building digital urban infrastructure informatization. Therefore, this article proposes a Hadoop based BIM cloud service spatial location retrieval framework. This framework combines cloud platforms with mobile users and the Internet to organize various services and applications required by BIM on cloud platforms, design urban spatial information retrieval trees and algorithms, and establish load balancing algorithms for accessing large user groups. Experimental verification shows that the architecture information established in this framework has fast response speed and strong processing concurrency ability, making it the best BIM cloud service framework.

articleTitle: IoT Botnet Detection: Application of Vision Transformer to Classification of Network Flow Traffic
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Despite the demonstrated effectiveness of transformer models in NLP, and image and video classification, the available tools for extracting features from captured IoT network flow packets fail to capture sequential patterns in addition to the absence of spatial patterns consequently limiting transformer model application. This work introduces a novel preprocessing method to adapt transformer models, the vision transformer (ViT) in particular, for IoT botnet attack detection using network flow packets. The approach involves feature extraction from .pcap files and transforming each instance into a 1-channel 2D image shape, enabling ViT-based classification. Also, the ViT model was enhanced to allow use any classifier besides Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) that was deployed in the initial ViT paper. Models including the conventional feed forward Deep Neural Network (DNN), LSTM and Bidirectional-LSTM (BLSTM) demonstrated competitive performance in terms of precision, recall, and F1-score for multiclass-based attack detection when evaluated on two IoT attack datasets.

articleTitle: The Impact of Blockchain as Advanced Technology on Digital Pricing and Bitcoin Industries
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In the last decade, bitcoin has grown in prominence. The unidentified and uncontrollable characteristics of bitcoins appeal to millions of individuals worldwide. Bitcoin study is devoted to locating the ether and estimating its digital pricing based on the bitcoin's previous digital pricing hikes. Because of the instantaneous prediction of digital pricing, earlier techniques for digital price prediction lack sufficient data and solutions for anticipating digital pricing shifts. We suggested a machine learning-based method for digital pricing prediction for a banking company depending on the challenges highlighted in Bitcoin digital pricing prediction. The suggested architecture includes a blockchain foundation for a secured deal setting and also a Reinforcement Learning technique for digital pricing assessment and prediction. The outcomes reveal that the provided framework outperforms another state-of-the-art method in terms of digital pricing prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Superstrate-based Low RCS Cavity-Backed Archimedean Spiral Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Spiral antennas are broadband circularly polarized antennas extensively used in radar warning systems, direction-finding radars, electronic warfare (EW) systems, etc. When EW antennas are mounted on a stealth platform, these antennas are required to have low radar cross-section (RCS) besides having a wideband operating frequency, high gain, low axial ratio (AR), and voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR). This paper presents the electromagnetic (EM) design of a low observable right-handed circularly polarized (RHCP) cavity-backed Archimedean spiral (CBAS) antenna with VSWR<2.2, AR<3 dB, and +ve gain over the frequency range of 2GHz to 18 GHz. In order to reduce the structural RCS of the designed CBAS antenna, a three-layered metasurface-based superstrate is placed at an optimum height (22mm) from the antenna aperture. It is shown that the addition of superstrate over the CBAS antenna has not degraded the EM performance of the antenna in terms of VSWR, axial ratio, gain, and radiation pattern. Monostatic/bistatic RCS of the CBAS antenna has been simulated for an RHCP plane wave incidence over 1-18 GHz. An RCS reduction of about 7dB (average) has been achieved without degradation in the radiation performance.

articleTitle: Multi-Sensor Fusion Robot Positioning Algorithm based on Beidou
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The role of positioning navigation in robots is very important, but there is a problem of bias in positioning locations. Ordinary systems cannot solve the positioning and navigation problem in robots, and the positioning results are not ideal. Therefore, this paper proposes a multi-sensor for precise positioning and navigation analysis. Firstly, the EKF algorithm is used to analyze the sensor, and the indicators are divided according to the positioning and navigation requirements to reduce them Locate distractors in navigation. Then, the EKF algorithm evaluates the robot positioning and navigation results to form a positioning navigation scheme and the positioning navigation results Conduct a comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under the condition of certain evaluation criteria, multi-sensor positioning and navigation accuracy and positioning navigation of robots are accurate The time is better than ordinary systems.

articleTitle: Aviation Safety Enhancement via NLP & Deep Learning: Classifying Flight Phases in ATSB Safety Reports
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Aviation safety is paramount, demanding precise analysis of safety occurrences during different flight phases. This study employs Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Deep Learning models, including LSTM, CNN, Bidirectional LSTM (BLSTM), and simple Recurrent Neural Networks (sRNN), to classify flight phases in safety reports from the Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB). The models exhibited high accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 scores, with LSTM achieving the highest performance of 87%, 88%, 87%, and 88%, respectively. This performance highlights their effectiveness in automating safety occurrence analysis. The integration of NLP and Deep Learning technologies promises transformative enhancements in aviation safety analysis, enabling targeted safety measures and streamlined report handling.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation Model of the Strategic Implementation of Power Grid Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In the composition of national economic growth, power grid enterprises are an important part, and the operation and development of power grid enterprises have received extensive attention. In order to achieve better and smoother development of power grid enterprises, its strategic execution is an important factor to ensure the realization of strategic goals. The assessment of the implementation of the strategy can provide a good picture of the degree of achievement of the strategic objectives. Traditional assessment methods cannot accurately assess the implementation of strategies. Therefore, this paper proposes an evaluation model for the analysis of strategic implementation. First, the computer is used to analyze the implementation of the strategy, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of the implementation of the strategy to reduce the implementation of the strategy in the interfering factor. Then, the computer evaluates the strategic implementation of the power grid enterprise, forms the strategic implementation plan, and conducts the strategic implementation results Comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under the condition of certain evaluation criteria, the evaluation model evaluates the accuracy of the strategic implementation of power grid enterprises. The authenticity of strategic performance assessments is superior to traditional assessment methods.

articleTitle: Solar Powered Water Pump Using Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The development of a switched reluctance motor water pump utilizing solar electricity and MATLAB simulation are shown in this article. The system aims to provide an efficient and sustainable solution for water pumping in remote areas. The solar panel capture the sunlight and convert it in to direct current (DC) electricity. The boost converter is used to boosting the voltage of solar panels to a high voltage level, which allows switching reluctance motors to be operated efficiently. A controller manages the power flow ensuring optimal performance of the motor and the overall system. To optimize the system performance and maximize the solar energy utilization, Algorithm for perturbing and observing (P&O) using Continuous maximum power point tracking (MPPT) monitors the solar panel output voltage and current, ensuring optimal energy extraction from the solar panel. The system coordinating the power flow between the solar panel, boost converter, and the SRM. Additionally, it regulates the switching of currents in the SRM windings based on feedback from the MPPT P&O algorithm, this control strategy ensures that the SRM operates at its most efficient points, enhancing the overall systems performance and extending the equipment’s lifespan.

articleTitle: Automated Detection of Similes and Oxymorons in Koshur and Awadhi Poetry: A Hybrid Algorithm Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Poetry, renowned for its magical and rhythmic qualities, incorporates various elements that contribute to its artistic allure. Among these elements, Figures of Speech (FsoS) play a significant role in enhancing the beauty of poetic compositions. This research paper focuses on two specific types of FsoS: Simile, known as 'उपमा', ‘Upma’ in Hindi and Oxymoron, referred to as 'ͪवरोधाभास', ‘Virodhabhas’ in the same language. The main objective of this study is to create automated algorithms capable of identifying similes and oxymorons within Koshur and Awadhi poetry. To achieve this, the researchers designed four distinct algorithms tailored to each language. These algorithms were then applied to a dataset containing 3200 poems in both Koshur and Awadhi. Given the absence of significant NLP resources for these languages, the authors encountered challenges in their work. They had to generate their own resources, including lists of antonyms for oxymorons and comparative words for similes. Impressively, after using Cohen’s Kappa the study achieved a strong level of agreement among human annotators, with an Inter-Annotator Agreement (IAA) score of 84.4% for Koshur and 91% for Awadhi. The automated algorithms also demonstrated notable accuracy, achieving 95% in both oxymoron and Simile for Koshur and for Awadhi it is 94% and 96% respectively. The authors also implemented the concept of hybridization, where mixing of different algorithms is done to achieve higher level of accuracy and authors successfully achieved 100% accuracy after hybridization. These results highlight the efficacy of the developed algorithms in detecting these poetic devices in the respective languages, despite the limited existing NLP resources available.

articleTitle: Stress Detection from Facial Expressions using Mini-Xception Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In today's fast-paced society, stress is a prevalent issue, and detecting it early can help prevent adverse health effects. Thus, Stress detection and identification in a person is very important. But locating it manually can be difficult. Facial expressions can provide valuable information on an individual’s stress levels. The proposed approach uses the MiniXception algorithm, a lightweight deep learning architecture that has shown promising results in various computer vision tasks. The algorithm takes facial images as input and extracts the facial features and detects the stress level of a person. The existing technique for the proposed system are CNN, ANN but the limitation is that the models use fixed filters that only capture information at a single scale. These are the results obtained in Detection of Stress from Facial Expressions. The real time image of a person is trapped from the camera, by processing the image the facial features are systematically retrieved one by one to analyze the feeling of a person either he is happy or sad or angry, after the emotions are detected, the stress levels are detected from facial features of a person. This model is constructed by using a deep learning algorithm called MiniXception algorithm. Using this algorithm we obtained an accuracy of 95.3 percent after 70epochs, which means that it shows best results for detecting stress using facial expressions.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Miniaturize Patch Antenna for C band and X band Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: A rectangular microstrip patch antenna is designed. The use for the X and C bands is being studied. The suggested antenna measures 28 x 30 mm and is mounted on a dielectric substrate Rogers RO3003 with a thickness of 1.6 mm and a dielectric constant of 3. Rectangular patch antenna with full ground and a small slot. The antenna operates at frequencies ranging from 4 GHz to 12 GHz, which correspond to the C and X bands, respectively. For three resonant frequencies, the return loss is -31.1917dB, -13.44dB, and - 15.838dB. In all three frequencies, the VSWR1 <1.5. Gain > 4dB for all the resonating frequencies. CST simulator is used to develop, optimise, and analyse the proposed antenna.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of a Web-Based Remote Triggered Laboratory for Characterization of Analog Components
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: This paper presents the development of an innovative Remote Triggered Laboratory (RTL) that enables remote characterization of analog components. Designed for the current era of online learning, the RTL, accessed via a web interface, provides a safe, efficient, and user-friendly approach for students to conduct experiments outside a traditional lab environment. This system focuses on the characterization of diodes, Bipolar Junction Transistors (BJTs), and Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor Field-Effect Transistors (MOSFETs). The setup incorporates relay modules and a PC connected through a USB interface. It employs Python-based software and an Arduino Mega controller, ensuring efficient execution and ease of use. The RTL also ensures safety by limiting user operation to prevent potentially dangerous situations. This advancement in remote labs opens up unrestricted experimental opportunities for students, improving accessibility and advancing the educational experience in semiconductor device characterization.

articleTitle: Optimizing Wireless Performance in Wearable Flexible Electronics: Antenna Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Flexible electronics refers to the utilization of pliable plastic substrates in the construction of elastic and bendable electrical circuits. Unlike conventional semiconductors and glass substrates, flexible electronics open up possibilities for entirely new product designs. This innovation hinges on the fabrication of electronic components on flexible plastic substrates like transparent conductive polyester film or polyimide, facilitating the assembly of electronic circuits. Remarkably, the same components employed in crafting rigid printed circuit boards can be repurposed for fashioning flexible electronic assemblies, allowing the board to flex and conform to desired shapes. In an alternative approach to flexible electronics, the standard silicon substrate must undergo thinning to a few tens of micrometers through etching processes, thereby achieving a bending radius of less than 5mm. The burgeoning growth of wearable technology, spanning global positioning systems (GPS), communication devices, health monitoring systems, and military applications, has propelled the rapid expansion of flexible antenna design and modeling. This surge reflects the pivotal role that flexible electronics play in enabling the evolution of these crucial industries.

articleTitle: Data Stream Classification for Anomaly Detection Using Ensemble of Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: A tough challenge in different fields, such as anomaly detection, fraud, and intrusion detection, is finding novel classes in data streaming. Classification techniques that are traditionally used have trouble detecting instances that correspond to undiscovered or unique classes that are absent from the dataset of training. This paper provides an ensemble model for enhancing the identification of anomalies in streaming data. Our method makes use of a group of classifiers, to make use of the combined wisdom and decision-making methods of various models. A portion of the data is used to train each classifier in the ensemble, which enhances generalization and accuracy. To enhance the detection of anomalies, we incorporate this ensemble model, which is trained on normal instances to capture the underlying distribution of known classes. It then detects instances that deviate significantly from the learned normal behavior, indicating the presence of potential novel classes. Concept drift detection is integrated into our methodology to monitor changes in the data distribution over time. Evaluation and experimentation on a real-world dataset, the KDD dataset, demonstrate the effectiveness of our ensemble-based approach for anomaly detection. The results show significant improvements in accuracy, precision, and recall compared to individual classifiers. Furthermore, the ensemble demonstrates robustness in handling concept drift and effectively identifies novel class instances in a streaming data environment.

articleTitle: User’s Age Detection Using Smartphone Motion Sensor Data
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: At the age of two, Children are smart enough to be able to use Smart devices. According to studies, children who spend more time on phones are exposed to health issues; moreover, accessing unwanted content leads to social and behavioral changes. To automatically regulate access to unwanted content on the internet, it is required to identify the age group of the user. In this work, the age of smartphone users is detected based on their implicit behavior in the form of the motion sensor reading. The dataset used is a publicly available dataset that consists of 100 child users and 100 adult users. Different Machine learning models such as KNN, LR, SVC, and Voting have been attempted to detect user age based on motion sensor readings. KNN offers the best performance with 97.30% F1-Score and 98.86% accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of SDN-based Flow Control Middleware
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The design of middleware plays a very important role in traditional networks and their devices, but there is a distributed control problem in only configurable and non-programmable networks. The TCP network model cannot solve the design problem of middleware in traditional networks and their devices, and the design is unreasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes an SDN flow control to analyze the design of various interface protocol middleware. Firstly, SDN software-defined network is used to design middleware, and indicators are divided according to the design requirements of middleware to reduce interference factors in middleware design. Then, SDN software-defined network builds the design of middleware with multiple interface protocols, forms the middleware design scheme, and comprehensively analyzes the middleware design results. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain design standards, SDN flow control is better than TCP network mode for the design accuracy and design time of middleware for constructing multiple interface protocols.

Author Keywords: Build a variety of interface protocols

articleTitle: Perfectly Keyless Commercial Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Accessing and sharing automobiles will become much simpler thanks to the wide range of automotive use cases made possible by digital keys. This study aims to provide digital keys to car owners and drivers so they can lock or unlock their automobiles and start the engine using a smartphone or other Bluetooth Low Energy-enabled mobile device. Private automobile owners can digitally lend their car keys to family members or friends without having to physically meet them, possibly for a certain period of time. Owners of company automobiles fleets can electronically distribute car keys to staff members, possibly granting access for a given day or length of time. Customers no longer need to physically pick up car keys at a rental desk because automobile owners can digitally transfer keys with them.

articleTitle: Multi-Robot Path Planning based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, people's requirements for robots are no longer limited to the research of single robots. With the emergence of robot production lines and the application of flexible manufacturing systems, the research of multi-robot has become an important direction of robotics research. Therefore, the role of robot path planning in the coordination and cooperation of multi-robot groups is very important, but there is a problem of inaccurate evaluation of results. The traditional algorithm cannot solve the path planning problem in the coordination and cooperation of multi-robot groups, and the evaluation is unreasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes an ant colony algorithm for innovative path planning analysis. First, the intelligent theory is used to evaluate the robot, and the indicators are divided according to the path planning requirements to reduce them Interference factors in path planning. Then, a multi-robot path planning scheme is formed, and the path planning results are comprehensively analyzed. MATLAB simulation shows that under the condition of certain evaluation criteria, the ant colony algorithm has the accuracy and path planning of multi-robot path planning the time is better than the traditional algorithm.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based UPI Technology for Secured Peer-to-Peer Cryptocurrency Transactions
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Today, the world is highly depended on Unified Payments Interface (UPI) system for all kind of financial transactions. Whether Banks or people, everyone relies on UPI transactions for personal or commercial purposes. Since it provides a simple interface with round the clock availability, the financial activities became easier and faster. But the security concerns are still there, for which continuous research processes are carried on all around the world. In the context of UPI system, the information security needs to be assured both during storage and transit. For providing security in information storage and data transfer, the best solution till now is Blockchain Technology enabled Smart Banking systems. The decentralized feature and use of smart contracts of Blockchain will help the transactions to be immutable, more secured and distributed. The usage of high degree cryptographic encryptions and usage of appropriate consensus algorithms can make the data purely tamper proof. This paper describes the features that should be possessed by a Blockchain technology enabled UPI system that will help to have high security for all the financial activities and transactions.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Control based Improved Congestion Management for Phase Shifting Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
