abstract: Power generation and distribution has significant impact on availabity of power. In order to regulate a phase-shifting transformer, fuzzy logic is best suited application in different conditions. In several large nations, phase shifting transformers have already been built as FACTS devices. It is used to enhance power transfer, lower transmission system costs, manage congestion, increase stability, and many other things. In this work, MATLAB software is used to analyse congestion management. As the demand on power transformers rises, some transformers experience power congestion. The phase shifting transformer can handle this strain, and the optimal management of phase shifting transformers is achieved through fuzzy logic control. Our experimental results show enhancement in the results over the state of arts.

articleTitle: Gradient Beetle Honey Badger Optimization based container migration and optimal key selection using Firefly Honey Badger Algorithm in cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Cloud migration involves virtual machines and containers, and the technology has many advantages, such as fault tolerance, manageability, load balancing, and energy efficiency. One of the biggest challenges in migration is securing the data that is migrated with the virtual machine or container. An effective approach for data security during container migration has been implemented using Gradient Beetle Honey Badger Optimization and Firefly Honey Badger Algorithm (GBHBA+FHBA) .At first, cloud model is simulated with PM, VM and containers. Here, tasks are assigned to VM in a round robin manner. The load prediction of VM and PM is done utilizing deep recurrent neural network (DRNN). Before container migration, data preservation is carried out using optimal key. The optimal key is selected employing Firefly Honey Badger Algorithm (FHBA), where FHBA is designed by combining Firefly algorithm (FA) and Honey Badger Algorithm (HBA). The container migration is conducted using proposed GBHBA by considering predicted load, migration cost, resource utilization, energy consumption and trust whereas GBHBA is the incorporation of Gradient Descent (GD) with Namib Beetle Optimization (NBO) and HBA. Additionally, GBHBA+FHBA attained minimum load of 0.126, minimum migration cost of 11.3 and minimum energy consumption of 0.041 respectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Towards the Digital Marketing Revolution
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The tremendous advancement of technology has had a significant impact on human life. In various industries, innovations have been employed. Artificial intelligence (AI) represents a contemporary science that tries to construct a machine that mimics human intelligence. It is employed in numerous fields, including banking, automation, medical services, and marketing. The purpose of this study is to investigate the impact of AI uses on digital marketing revaluation and their comparative benefit for digital marketing firms. The writers took a descriptive-analytical method. It looked at three aspects of AI: natural language processing, motion guidance, expert systems, marketing emails, and the usage of automated machinery. An online survey with twenty-eight elements is being created to investigate this influence. The study population included digital marketers and staff of marketing firms, where the investigator issued 300 surveys to a random sample, and 288 legitimate surveys were recovered for study objectives. SPSS is used to evaluate the data gathered. The findings demonstrate that AI uses have a quantitatively significant influence on digital marking and its competitive benefit.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of an Double Balanced Mixer for Radar Applications at X band
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: As there is a rising demand for new scientific and technological advancement in wireless communication, there is large potential of research in this area of expertise. For any wireless system, it is essential to include a transmitter, channel of propagation and a receiver. The most critical component in a receiver is the mixer. This paper shows an Double-balanced Active mixer that is designed to receive radar frequencies working at X band, which is Down-converted at operable frequency, for various RADAR applications. A pHEMT Transistor with ATF-36077 part number is utilized for down-converting an RF signal of 10GHz with an LO Signal of 10.07GHz, with an input power of -2dBm at LO Path and -10dBm at the RF Path to get an output response at 70MHz as IF. The transistor undergoes biasing and stability checks across various frequencies. To enhance conversion gain of the mixer and achieve return loss matching, a circuit is crafted specifically for the transistor. The topology chosen is the Double Balanced Mixer containing active components in the Gilbert cell configuration. This Mixer circuit is meticulously designed and simulated using ADS. The achieved Conversion Gain obtained for this mixer results to 10.04 dB, The design showcasing excellent linearity and return loss along with a commendable conversion gain.

articleTitle: Research on Electromagnetic Characteristics of Metamaterial based on FDTD Algorithm and Physical Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The role of electromagnetic properties in the properties of meta materials is very important, but there is a problem of inaccurate evaluation of results. The light transformation theory cannot solve the problem of electromagnetic properties in the properties of meta materials, and the evaluation is unreasonable. Therefore, an FDTD algorithm and physical model is proposed for electromagnetic characteristic analysis. Firstly, the rotation equation theory is used to evaluate the meta material, and the index is divided according to the electromagnetic characteristics to reduce the electromagnetic characteristics in the interfering factor. Then, the rotation equation theory analyzes the electromagnetic characteristics, forms an electromagnetic characteristic scheme, and synthesizes the electromagnetic characteristics, results Analyses. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, FDTD algorithm and physical model for meta materials The accuracy of electromagnetic characteristics and the time of electromagnetic characteristics is better than the light transformation theory.

articleTitle: A Power Supply Service Quality Analysis Method Based on Information Entropy Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The role of power supply quality in power supply service is very important, but there is a problem of unqualified power supply quality. Traditional methods cannot solve the problem of power supply quality in power supply services, and the solution results are unreasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes an information entropy decision tree algorithm for power supply quality analysis. Firstly, the machine learning method is used to evaluate the power supply quality, and the indicators are divided according to the power supply quality requirements to reduce the power supply quality in the interfering factor. Then, the machine learning method forms a power supply quality scheme for the power supply service power quality, and synthesizes the power supply quality results Analyse. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the information entropy decision tree algorithm has a quality effect on the power supply quality of the power supply service. The quality and reliability of power supply are better than traditional methods.

articleTitle: A Deep Dive into Gender Classification Using Inception V3: Performance and Insights
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The study of images for the purpose of gender classification has garnered considerable interest in academic circles, owing to its wide-ranging applications in industries such as marketing, healthcare, security, and entertainment. This study investigates the utilization of the InceptionV3 convolutional neural network architecture in the context of gender classification. The InceptionV3 model, renowned for its profound and effective feature extraction skills, has been extensively employed in applications related to picture categorization. The aim of our study is to utilize the capabilities of InceptionV3 in order to effectively estimate gender labels based on facial photos. The utilization of the InceptionV3 architecture is thereafter employed to extract hierarchical features from the aforementioned photos. The unique inception modules included in the design incorporate convolutional filters of different sizes, which play a significant role in capturing multi-scale information that is essential for the task of gender classification. The findings demonstrate the effectiveness of InceptionV3 in properly predicting gender labels based on facial photos. The versatility of the architecture, its capacity to extract features, and its efficient utilization of GPU resources contribute to its robustness as a suitable option for gender categorization applications. However, it is important to highlight the necessity of ethical considerations, given that gender is a multifaceted and intricate construct that surpasses simplistic binary classification. This study makes a valuable contribution to the expanding field of research on gender classification and emphasizes the significance of deploying models in a responsible and unbiased manner.

articleTitle: Using Dynamic Pivot Trading System To Make Profitable Trades
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Day trading community has many techniques to guide the user on where to enter a trade (buy or sell) and when to close (square-off) the trade. None of the known techniques gives consistent net profit at the end of the year across all trading platforms. Moreover, the techniques that work on a trending market are different from the techniques that work when the market moves in sideways. Identifying whether market is entering in trending or sideways is also not easy. In this paper we shall pick moving average indicator and how dynamic pivot system used in a specific way improves performance of moving average indicator. There is a reason behind why we picked moving average indicator for this paper. Moving average indicator is one of the best known and simple method many traders use. It is known that, this indicator works well during trending market and gives lots of false signals when the market is in sideways. Many indicators use moving average principle; for example, MACD and Moving average cross over indicator. It can be shown that dynamic pivot system improves performance of all these families of indicators. The system introduced in this paper is verified with three years of data in Indian and US markets.

articleTitle: Structured Analysis of Traffic Video based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Peak video structure as an important basis in the process of traffic system, what important role for traffic violations, but in the process of teaching video structure analysis, there are some problems such as data fusion and poor feature recognition. Therefore, I propose an intelligent method to optimize the traffic structure, promote the fusion between different data and feature values, and make the video more easily recognized. The research results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can make the blurred image clear, and realize the overall analysis of data, which can be supported by traffic violations and other operations, so this algorithm can meet the relevant requirements.

articleTitle: Implementation of Low Power VLSI Architecture using Adiabatic Logic
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The need of low power consuming CMOS designs has increased to meet the emerging technology raise in the market. In CMOS, power that is lost as heat energy during the discharging phase can be eliminated by using ‘Adiabatic Logic’. This paper brings you the implementation of 2:1 Multiplexer (MUX) and 1:2 De-Multiplexer (DE-MUX) using Adiabatic Logic. Our simulation results reveals that the power consumption of MUX and DE-MUX is reduced by 60% and delay is reduced by 80% according to the 90, 180 nm technologies. This Low Power Consuming MUX and DE-MUX can be used in the fields of parallel data communication, design of computer memory, data transmission.

articleTitle: GaN-Powered Vector control for Electric Vehicle PMSM Drive
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: This paper gives a comprehensive look into the field oriented control (FOC) of surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous motors (SPSMs) being driven by GaN inverters. Field-oriented control has received a lot of attention in recent years because of its ability to give accurate control of motor performance, making it ideal for a variety of industrial applications. Adding to this, the use of wide band gap devices such as GaN in the inverter feeding the motor provides advantages such as compact size, high power density, high switching operation, and thus improved efficiency. The study includes simulation results of the SPMSM drive employing the FOC technique with the use of a GaN inverter. The overall functionality of the model under steady state was simulated and verified using PLECS software.

Author Keywords: Surface mount permanent magnet synchronous machine (SPMSM)

articleTitle: Sequential Model Utilization for Fruits Classification Using Optimized Deep Learning Methods on Adam Optimizer On Fine-Tuned Epochs
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Fruit classification is the process of grouping various fruit species and variations according to their distinctive traits, such as form, size, colour, texture, and other distinguishing properties. In a variety of fields and businesses, such as agriculture, biology, food science, nutrition, and technology, this category has a number of uses. Fruit categorization is to develop organised methods that make different fruit varieties simple to recognise, examine, and use. A common use of computer vision and machine learning methods as suggested in this research is the categorization of fruits using deep learning. Overall, classifying fruits using deep learning is a difficult problem that needs a significant quantity of annotated data and sophisticated deep learning methods. Nonetheless, it has a sustainable wide range of useful applications, including quality control and inventory management in the food business. Moreover, fundamental machine learning methods are applied to illustrate the outcomes. The work is highly helpful in locating fruits among several categories with good accuracy in prediction in addition to visualisation. Hence, those involved in the fruit and vegetable sector will ultimately benefit greatly from this social policy. The suggested sequential model's highly accurate accuracy of 98 percent prediction for suitable visualisation is quite clear as it uses Adam optimizer and epoch of value 35 and other optimized parameters.

articleTitle: Multiclass Arrhythmia Classification using Histogram Gradient Boosting
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Arrhythmias, which affect the pace or rhythm of the heartbeat, might occasionally appear irregularly throughout a subject’s everyday activities. A Holter device is frequently used to collect long-term electrocardiogram (ECG) data in order to capture these rare episodes. It is challenging to assess the ECG data that Holter monitors produce. As a result, each heartbeat must be analyzed and categorized with the aid of a computer. ECG signals may be accurately and quickly classified using the Histogram Gradient Boosting (HGB) Classifier. In this study, we offered a strategy for classifying ECG heartbeats based on the HGB. Using data from the MIT-BIH arrhythmia database, our offered technique had 97.95% overall accuracy.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Melanoma using EfficientNet B4 Transfer Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Melanoma is one of the most widespread types of skin cancer, and if not caught early, it can be dangerous. The number of avoidable fatalities can be decreased by using a reliable, automatic method that can detect the presence of melanoma from a dermatoscopic image of lesions and skin pigmentation. Deep learning algorithms have demonstrated promising results in recent studies for creating automated diagnosis for precise disease detection. This paper proposes an EfficientNetB4 network model architecture for organizing melanoma pictures into melanoma and not melanoma classes. The projected EfficientNet B4 model involves of 9 layers. In this proposed work, 17,805 images are used in the dataset. The model was trained 90 times, with learning rate 0.0001. Results shows that the proposed EfficientNet B4 model achieved a high accuracy of 96%. Overall, the study shows encouraging results and emphasizes EfficientNet B4's potential to be an essential tool for early detection of melanoma skin cancers.

articleTitle: A Stacked SRAM Cell with Asymmetric Threshold Voltage for Low Leakage Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: When designing low-power VLSI circuits, power dissipation is one of the most difficult issues to solve. The leakage power increases as the device's size decreases. As a result, CMOS chips have a serious issue with power leakage. Submicron technology brings with it a decrease in device stability and a lower threshold voltage. When the supply voltage is lowered, the threshold voltage and oxide thickness decrease due to the increased leakage current. Several methods for lowering leakage current are studied in this research. This paper details the process of asymmetrically stacking thresholds in a Static Random Access Memory (SRAM) cell. Leakage current and energy usage are minimized because of the make use of asymmetric threshold stacked inverters in the suggested design structure. By simulating the proposed AT-S SRAM cell in the Synopsys HSPICE Tool, we found that its leakage power consumption could be reduced while its throughput on a 16 nm technology library could be increased.

articleTitle: Web Intrusion Detection with Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Web intrusion detection involves the identification and thwarting of unauthorized access or attacks targeting web applications. With the increasing use of the internet and the rise in cybercrime, web intrusion detection has become an essential aspect of cybersecurity. This report paper provides an overview of various web intrusion detection techniques, including signature-based, anomaly-based, and hybrid approaches. The paper also discusses the challenges and limitations of web intrusion detection and highlights the importance of using multiple detection techniques to improve accuracy and reduce false positives. Additionally, the paper covers the latest trends in web intrusion detection, such as machine learning-based approaches, and concludes with recommendations for improving web intrusion detection in the future.Web intrusion detection is also a crucial aspect of cybersecurity in modern times. As web applications become more prevalent, the likelihood of attacks also increases, making it necessary to have robust mechanisms in place to detect and prevent such attacks. In this report paper, we explore various techniques for web intrusion detection, including signature-based and anomaly based approaches.

articleTitle: An Efficient High Performance GDI based 4-bit Vedic Multiplier in 32nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: System performance improves with good multiplier performance. In today’s digital world, the speed of the multiplier is a crucial factor, but it also has a high power consumption. Power and delay optimisation of multipliers will be pivotal. The choice of adder units in the multiplier also takes into account adders such the Ripple carry adder(RCA), carry look-ahead adder(CLA), and carry skip adder(CSA). This research investigates the differences between several adders implemented in Vedic multiplier using CMOS, transmission gate and GDI based techniques. When attempting to design a Vedic multiplier with CMOS transistors and Transmission gates, the circuit will experience problems such as delay, power and area metrics. These problems can be addressed by employing the Gate Diffusion Input (GDI) logic. This uses GDI logic to keep delay, power, and the number of transistors as low as feasible. In this research, a GDI-based 4-bit Vedic multiplier was built in 32nm technology and compared to a CMOS and TG-based vedic multiplier design. GDI-based 4-bit Vedic Multiplier systems were faster, used less power, and took up less area than CMOS and TG-based systems. This 4-bit Vedic multiplier design can be used in the Tanner EDA tool with different adders.

articleTitle: Bar Code Based Attendance System
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The Barcode Scanning based Attendance System is a Python project for college students and professors. Using tkinter and pyzbar libraries, it scans barcode ID cards with a camera and retrieves details from an Excel sheet. This automated system updates attendance records in Excel, saving time and reducing errors. It offers a user-friendly solution for efficient attendance management in educational institutions.

articleTitle: Viral Pneumonia Detection from Chest X-rays using GLCM and LBP features
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The early contact less detection of viral pneumonia is important as the virus have the ability to mutate and adapt frequently resulting in an epidemic situation or potential pandemic in a short time. This work unveils a technique for identifying viral pneumonia from chest X-rays. A combination of Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) and Local Binary Pattern (LBP) features with Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier is used for detection. The effect of various classifiers and feature combinations on viral pneumonia detection are also assessed. From the experimental results, the combination of GLCM and LBP features along with SVM classifier gives the best result with an accuracy of 90.5% and F1 score of 0.9073 compared to stat-of-the-art.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Vectorization Techniques and Machine Learning Models for Hate Speech Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: It is now more important than ever to identify hate speech in digital communication in order to preserve a welcoming and safe online community. Utilizing a three-class classification dataset, this research study gives a thorough analysis of hate speech detection for English textual data. We methodically investigated a variety of vectorization and embedding methods, such as Tfidf Vectorizer, Count Vectorizer, Word2Vec, and GloVe, along with a wide range of machine learning models, including Random Forest, AdaBoost, and Logistic Regression. In order to determine the best method for detecting hate speech in textual content, we rigorously evaluated and conducted extensive experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of different combinations.

articleTitle: Smart Electronic Vehicle System (EV)
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: We all know that Electric Vehicles are the future of society, many private companies are involved in the manufacturing of electrical vehicles.We find that there are various systems that can be automated, so we decided to automate wipers of the car and Monitor the battery life of the car. We have used an open cv with mediapipe framework for recognition. ArduinoIDE and Pycharm IDE are used to make this project, the whole project is written in python(3.7.6) and c++.To send the data from Pycharm to Arduino IDE we have used cvzone library.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Phase Locked Loop with Different Phase Frequency Detectors using 90nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Phase Locked Loops (PLL) are used most frequently for clock generation and clock recovery in microprocessor, networking, communication, and frequency synthesizer systems. Phase locked loops are frequently employed in high-performance digital systems to produce precisely timed on-chip clocks. Phase Locked Loop is used in contemporary wireless communication systems primarily for synchronization, clock synthesis, skew and jitter reduction. A PLL circuit with quicker locking ability is required since circuit operation speed has increased. The GHz frequency band is where many of today's communication systems operate. Therefore, a PLL with a shorter lock time that can function in the GHz range is required. Due to the PLL's architecture, it combines digital and analog signal processing units. The current study focuses on redesigning a PLL system using CADENCE Virtuoso Analog Design Environment and the 90nm manufacturing technology.A Current Starved Voltage Controlled Oscillator (CSVCO) has been taken into consideration for its superior performance in the form of low power consumption and wide tunable frequency range. In this case, develop various Phase Frequency Detectors (PFD) are Type 1 and Type 2 PFD, Charge Pump, Low Pass Filter (LPF), frequency divider, and current starved ring are used to implement the PLL, and comparisons are made. Each block's power and delay are computed, as well as the PLL's power and delay with two types of PFDs.

articleTitle: Offline Mathematical Expression Evaluator using Non-Linear SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The Offline Handwritten Expression Evaluator [OHMEE] is a Machine Learning Model used to recognize and solve the Offline Handwritten Mathematical Expressions [OHME]. The term Offline refers to documents, images, papers and transcripts. We perform Image Pre-processing steps like Image Segmentation, Character Segmentation, Normalization and Binarization to covert the Image data to appropriate training data for the model using OpenCV Library. The character images in the [OHME] are classified and recognized using Non-Linear Support Vector Machines [SVM] and they are converted to appropriate Strings. These Strings are solved using user-defined mathematical methods. These modules are used to evaluate these String expressions and the appropriate results are generated and plotted.

articleTitle: Design of a T-slot Based Microstrip Patch Antenna with Reduced Cross Polarization
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: This paper presents a design of a Microstrip patch antenna for low-power applications, operating at a frequency of 948MHz. The antenna is having a broadside radiation pattern, linear polarization, and high directivity. The radiating rectangular patch of the antenna is optimized with a T-shaped slot to achieve the desired frequency and a gain of 5.3 dBi. An inset feed line is used to efficiently feed the antenna, while a ground plane beneath the patch enhances its overall performance. To thoroughly investigate the Microstrip patch's characteristics, a comprehensive parametric study is conducted. The s11 obtained is -28.6 dB with a cross polarization of -30.4 dBi. The proposed antenna design holds promise for various low-power applications like UAV communications where reliable communication and efficient signal reception are crucial.

articleTitle: Implementation and Enabling Internet of Things (IoT) in Wireless communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT), which is utilized for data collection and long-distance wireless communications, has assimilated into contemporary life. There is a problem with transferring, preserving, and analyzing a lot of statistics as a result of the growth in IoT applications. Precision agriculture (PA) can now be used because to enhancements in wireless communication and current computer technology. In this research, we analyze the agricultural application situations and empirical experiments to find acceptable, realistic and practicable wireless communication systems for PA. For PA uses, 3 different types of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) architectures depending on narrowband IoT (NB-IoT), long range (Lo-Ra), and zig-bee wireless communication systems are implemented an enabled. Three WSN systems' viability is confirmed by related tests. The energy usage of 3 wireless communication systems are contrasted by evaluating the average communication period. Field trials and in-depth assessment reveal that Lo-Ra and NB-IoT are two viable wireless communication systems for field agriculture situations, whereas ZigBee is a superior option for tracking establishment agriculture.

articleTitle: Design of Hardwired Control Unit Using Reversible Gates for RISC Architecture Based Processor
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In today’s world, with the advancements in the VLSI technology, we are able to integrate more and more devices on single chip this increases the chip complexity. Due to the high density of the chip, the power dissipation becomes major concern for design. Reversible logic has drawn a lot of interest recently as a means of easing power issues. By recovering bit loss from its special input-output mapping, it uses less energy.The Control Unit's central processing unit (CPU) plays a crucial role in governing the operations of a computer's processor. This paper introduces a reversible Hardwired control unit, which encompasses novel components like the reversible decoder and J-K flip-flop. These elements are built using two innovative 4x4 reversible gates called the HL gate and BJ gate. Their combined functionality allows for effective control over the processor's operations. Specially created hardware logical circuits produce the control signals necessary for instruction execution control. The results of comparing these circuits with the conventionally built circuits are displayed.

articleTitle: Research on Neural Network-based Transformer Algorithm in Dialogue System
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The role of dialogue systems in neural networks is very important, but there is a problem of inaccurate results. Ordinary methods cannot solve the problem of dialogue systems in neural networks, and the results of solving them are not ideal. Therefore, this paper proposes a Transformer algorithm to analyze neural network dialogue system. First, artificial intelligence is used to analyze the dialogue system, and indicators are divided according to the requirements of the dialogue system to reduce the dialogue system in the interfering factor. Then, the artificial intelligence analyzes the results of the neural network dialogue system, forms a dialogue system scheme, and conducts the dialogue system results Comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the Transformer algorithm is a dialogue system for neural networks The accuracy of the results and the controllability of the dialogue system were better than ordinary methods.

articleTitle: Text-to-Image Synthesis using stackGAN
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In text-to-image conversion, it can be challenging to produce visuals of a high caliber from written descriptions. Examples created using traditional text to image approaches can usually convey the meaning of the descriptions given, but they are deficient in important details and vibrant object aspects. The creation of photo-realistic graphics from text has several applications, including photo editing, computer-aided design, gaming, virtual reality, and medical imaging. This project suggests using StackGANs, or stacked generative adversarial networks, to create accurate images depending on the text given. There are two phases to StackGAN. Stage-I GAN generates low-resolution representations of the object by sketching its basic form and colors from the text provided. The Stage-II GAN uses text descriptions and Stage-I discoveries as inputs to create high-resolution images with lifelike qualities.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Optimized Based 32-Bit Arithmetic and Logical Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The 32-bit Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) is a critical component within modern microprocessors and digital systems, responsible for performing various arithmetic and logic operations on 32-bit binary data. It serves as the computational heart of the central processing unit (CPU), enabling the execution of arithmetic computations, comparisons, and logical operations necessary for data processing. The miniaturizing a digital circuit can be accomplished by either decreasing the size of the transistor (in accordance with Moore’s Law) or by increasing the number of gates present in the circuit. Ultimately, the result is an area-optimized architecture / approach that optimizes the circuit at the gate level. A 32 bit ALU design and implementation for optimized process explain in this paper. This paper also illustration of the 32-bit ALU in form of the power consumption and also Delay in terms of the propagation this whole scenario is designed in the Xilinx ISE Design suite 14.7 and the program written in the Verilog.

articleTitle: Osteoarthritis Classification Using MobileNetV3 Model by Data Pre-processing and Depiction on Fine - Tuned Optimized Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: A frequent degenerative joint illness that damages the cartilage, the protective tissue that covers the ends of bones inside a joint, is osteoarthritis, sometimes known as OA. It can result in discomfort, stiffness, swelling, and a reduction in the range of motion in the joints that are afflicted. Osteoarthritis may affect any joint, including the hands, feet, and shoulders, although it most frequently affects weight-bearing joints like the knees, hips, and spine. Age, obesity, joint damage, repeated joint usage, genetic susceptibility, and other underlying medical issues such metabolic disorders are all risk factors for developing osteoarthritis. The categorization of osteoarthritis in this research is done using MobileNetV3 neural network architecture. In applications where computing resources are constrained, such as on mobile phones or other edge devices, MobileNetV3 is a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture that is created to be effective and suited for deployment on mobile devices. To effectively fight osteoarthritis in its beginning stages, it is important to first determine its type or category. Our MobileNetV3 model is very good at classifying osteoarthritis, achieving an accuracy rate of over 80%.

articleTitle: Task Scheduling and Workload Forecasting Approach for Cloud Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: As the need for data storage, processing, and advanced computing continues to rise, there is a growing demand across diverse engineering and technology sectors.the integration of cloud computing has become nearly indispensable. However, cloud-based platforms, while offering significant capabilities, are constrained by resources and require effective task distribution for balanced workload management. This task distribution is further enhanced when there is a prior estimate of the cloud workload. Consequently, both workload forecasting and task scheduling become intricate tasks that demand meticulous execution. In this paper, we introduce a methodology centered on heuristics to address task scheduling, aiming to optimize the allocation of tasks efficiently. Additionally, we introduce a machine learning-based approach for workload forecasting to provide a reliable estimate of future workloads. The performance of the task scheduling approach is evaluated with a focus on key metrics such as execution time and Central Processing Unit (CPU) usage. Simultaneously, the effectiveness of workload forecasting approach is assessed based on criteria including regression, mean absolute percentage error, mean square error, and the numbers of iterations required for training. Through this comprehensive evaluation, we aim to gauge the effectiveness of our proposed methods in enhancing the efficiency and performance of cloud computing systems.

articleTitle: Graphic Image Segmentation Method based on High-Precision and Fast Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The role of graphic image segmentation in image processing is very important, but there is a problem that the segmentation results are not satisfactory. The ordinary segmentation method cannot solve the problem of graphic image segmentation in image processing, and the results of graphic image segmentation do not meet expectations. Therefore, this paper proposes a high-precision and fast algorithm for graphic image segmentation analysis. First, the computer is used to analyze the graphic image, and the index is divided according to the requirements of the graphic image segmentation to reduce the graphic image segmentation in the interfering factor. Then, the computer analyzes the results of graphic image segmentation to form a graphic image segmentation scheme, and performs the graphic image segmentation results Comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, high-precision and fast algorithms can segment the graphics images RI LPDJH SURFHVVLQJ accurately The convenience of graphic image segmentation is better than that of ordinary segmentation method.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Photovoltaic Properties of Cs2BiAgI6 Perovskite Solar Cells via Acceptor Density Control
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The present investigation is driven by computer simulations conducted utilizing the SCAPS 1D program. The metal halide perovskite Cs<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>BiAgI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> possesses intriguing defect-tolerant properties and can be easily processed, rendering it an attractive candidate for high-performance solar applications. The material Cs<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>BiAgI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> exhibits a range of acceptor densities, spanning from 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup> to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. This paper provides a thorough analysis of the intricate interplay between varying levels of acceptor density within the Cs<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>BiAgI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> framework and their subsequent impact on the efficiency of photovoltaic systems. This work seeks to elucidate the profound influence of acceptor density on key photovoltaic parameters through the implementation of a methodical and analytical methodology. The aforementioned elements comprise the dynamics of carriers, methods of recombination, and the overall efficiency of the device. The findings underscore the significance of acceptor density in the customization process of photovoltaic cells utilizing Cs<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>BiAgI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>, hence accentuating its impact on the observed variations in efficiency.

articleTitle: Smart Refrigerator Management System Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In today’s modern era smart home appliances with new features and technologies plays a vital role to make human life easier. One of the essential and common home appliances is a Refrigerator which helps to preserve Food and Vegetables. There are many Smart Refrigerators available in the Market with integrated cameras WI-FI and Embedded Technologies. By incorporating artificial intelligence and deep learning to enhance the refrigerator’s functioning, smart refrigerators aid in the management of food. Deep Learning Technology is being used to detect the fruits inside the Refrigerator. This is necessary to detect the fruits present inside the refrigerator and keep the track of count present inside it productively and precisely. The goal of this work is to optimize and deploy the trained model in order to capture and categorize images inside the refrigerator in real time. To make fruit classification and recognition more accurate, we created an customised dataset to train and test the model with YOLOv7 deep learning algorithm. Proposed work is also extended to classify the bad and good quality of fruits. The entire system has been implemented using hardware based on NVIDIA Jetson Nano. The suggested system employs a wide-angle camera to capture images towards object recognition and inventory control. It provides an augmented pictures by considering different positions, perspectives, and lighting conditions along with manually created labels. This system also improves the occlusion problem of fruits present inside the inventory. Evaluation of this work reveals that the accuracy is obtained up to 98% with 35 FPS against the YOLOv3 which is attaining an avarage accuracy of 92.45%.

articleTitle: Comparative Performance Analysis of Lithium-ion and Lead-acid Batteries for Electric Scooters: A Simulink Modelling Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The increasing fascination in electric scooters as an environmentally friendly means of transportation in metropolitan areas has placed significant emphasis on the performance of their power sources, specifically batteries. The present work undertakes a complete comparative examination of two widely used battery technologies, namely Lithium-ion (Li-ion) and Lead-acid. The models for both types of batteries were methodically constructed using the powerful capabilities of Simulink, which is a simulation-based environment. The aim of the study is to evaluate the performance metrics of the subjects under controlled and consistent conditions, in order to gain valuable insights about their compatibility with electric scooters. The initial findings suggest that there are noticeable differences in performance between the two, with each exhibiting distinct benefits and difficulties. This study not only makes a valuable contribution to the scholarly discussion on battery technologies but also offers practical insights for manufacturers and players in the electric scooter market, facilitating well-informed decision-making.

articleTitle: The Rise of Smart Retail: Enhancing Operations with Cutting-Edge Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Retailers' operations, process optimization, and customer experience delivery have all been significantly impacted by the incorporation of AI and ML technology. The need of smart retail is emphasized, as are its potential advantages. Retailers can improve their inventory management, supply chain efficiency, and customer-centric marketing with the help of AI and ML, which can sift through massive volumes of data and provide actionable insights. Better operational efficiency, lower costs, more profits, and happier customers are the results of adopting best retail practices. It delves into how AI-powered systems automate stock control, provide reliable demand predictions, and optimize replenishment procedures to achieve optimum stock levels at little expense. Chatbots and virtual assistants powered by artificial intelligence are explored in terms of their potential to improve customer service and provide more tailored suggestions. Artificial intelligence and machine learning are recognized for their usefulness in analyzing client data to get insight into preferences, habits, and purchasing patterns. Because of this, stores may provide more individualized services, run more effective targeted promotions, and strengthen relationships with loyal customers.

articleTitle: Identification of Information Calumny using Sarcasm Features
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: With extensive access to the internet, information gets spread rapidly, leading to a generation of misinformation affecting the life of people, businesses, etc. The researchers have been keen on identifying solutions to this problem of misinformation generation. Machine learning and deep learning-based approaches are becoming popular to develop automated models to identify information calumny. The machine learning-based models are based on a feature extraction process. Handcrafted features play a crucial role in model development. This includes content or text and user-specific features. One type of significant feature is sarcasm, which is used to communicate emotions in a way opposite to what it actually means to be. This feature can undoubtedly assist in identifying the credibility of contents and information calumny. Previous researchers have studied the sarcasm in fake news but have not used these as features to develop models. Authors have proposed a novel approach to identify information calumny with sarcasm to fill this gap. The proposed method showed the highest accuracy of 93.88%.

articleTitle: Implementing Bit Manipulation Instructions on Architecture of RISC-V Processor
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: A consumer electronic computing device requires a system that is effective, low-cost, low-power, highly energy-efficient, and secure. To fulfill these requirements, the RISC-V Instruction Set Architecture (ISA) has gained widespread popularity due to its support for extensive ISA extensions with specialized variants and compatibility with direct native hardware implementation. However, to enhance program runtime effectiveness and reduce power consumption in low-cost embedded-based and Internet of Things (IoT) devices, Bit Manipulation Instructions (BMIs) were developed by ARM and Intel. As a result, the learning focuses on the simplified design of the open-source RISC-V (RV32I)-based "bitRISC" processor, a fully synthesizable 32-bit CPU. This design incorporates up to 16 arithmetic and logical operations within the ISA.The "bitRISC" processor is a single-cycle processor developed using Verilog HDL and a condensed design approach. It was prototyped using the cadence tool, and power and area reports were generated and analyzed to ensure optimal performance and efficiency.

articleTitle: Enhancing Traffic Efficiency through Real-Time Traffic Signal Control Using Deep Q-Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: This research manuscript delves into the employment of advanced technologies for the enhancement of traffic efficiency, leveraging real-time data and deep reinforcement learning methodologies. We focus on the formulation of a specialized Deep Q-learning agent, capable of effectively managing traffic light operations at an isolated junction, utilizing real-time GPS data. The amalgamation of deep neural networks with the Q-learning component of reinforcement learning enables the agent to refine traffic signal control strategies. The Deep Q-Network (DQN) algorithm is utilized, in combination with replay memory and a target network, to bolster and stabilize the learning journey. The agent’s training process employs Q-learning with experience replay within the traffic simulator SUMO, fostering the production of traffic signal control policies. The suggested method aspires to curtail traffic congestion and reduce waiting periods by facilitating intersections to make judicious decisions premised on their real-time status. The metrics are queue length and reward of the agent which are carefully monitored for the best result.

articleTitle: Survey on Machine Learning Techniques for the Identification and Classification of Plant Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Plant diseases can have a significant impact on both the quantity and quality of agricultural products, as well as the security of food production. Plant diseases might be so severe that no grains are harvested at all. This paper provides an overview of the many techniques to classifying plant diseases. A variety of approaches rely on computer vision and image processing methods. In comparison to a traditional technique, a machine learning methodology makes it easier to diagnose certain diseases. As a result, it can recognise the badly damaged leaves in the images using machine learning techniques. The pictures taken by the camera will be processed using a number of image processing techniques. Classification is the process of categorising each sample into separate categories. Determining the best classification method might be challenging because outcomes are dependent on the input data. This paper examines a few machine learning algorithms for plant leaf disease detection and classifications, as well as a brief overview, in order to detect and classify leaf diseases. Along with these, a few challenges and research gaps, as well as potential solutions are discussed.

articleTitle: Detection of Indian Regional Sign Language Through Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The objective of this endeavor is to create a specialized sign language recognition system created specifically for Kannada, an indigenous language spoken in India. While there are existing recognition systems for widely spoken languages like Hindi and English, there is a lack of resources and options for regional languages like Kannada. By leveraging a dataset of 50,000 Kannada sign language samples, The objective of this initiative is to close the communication divide experienced by individuals who rely on Kannada sign language, effectively addressing the need for improved interaction. The project focuses on exploring and comparing various AI and DL models to identify the most effective approach for Kannada sign language recognition. The ultimate goal is to enhance accessibility, inclusivity, and understanding for individuals communicating in Kannada sign language, thereby promoting cultural diversity and equal opportunities for the Kannada-speaking sign language community in India. The results and consequences of this endeavor have the potential to lay the groundwork for the advancement of location-specific sign language recognition systems. This would significantly enhance communication and promote the self-determination of individuals with hearing impairments residing in the Kannada-speaking areas of India.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach of Skin Cancer Classification using Hybrid CNN-Inception Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Skin cancer is a prevalent and potentially fatal health issue; therefore, early and correct diagnosis is critical for effective treatment. Even while visual identification is feasible, it is very challenging due to considerable inter-class similarities and intra-class variability. Since this condition is so widespread, various deep learning-based automated algorithms have been created to aid doctors in spotting skin lesions at an early stage. This study proposed a weighted average ensemble learning-based system for classifying seven different types of skin lesions. As the foundation of this ensemble, this study used four distinct deep neural network architectures: ResNet, Inception, a hybrid model combining CNN and VGG16, and a hybrid CNN with Inception model. The publicly available HAM10000 and ISIC 2019 datasets, totaling 18,730 dermoscopy images, were used in the training and evaluation process with class balancing, noise reduction, and data augmentation techniques, to train and evaluate our models. The four models all did quite well in the evaluations; the Average Validation accuracy for DenseNet, Inception, Hybrid model of CNN and VGG16, and Hybrid model of CNN and Inception is 90.47%, 89.95%, 97.39%, and 98.44% respectively.

articleTitle: Skin Cancer Detection Using the HAM10000 Dataset: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Skin cancer is a prevalent and potentially life-threatening disease that requires early and accurate detection for effective treatment. Existing skin cancer detection procedures face limitations in terms of accuracy and efficiency. To overcome these limitations, we put forward a novel solution that leverages machine learning models to classify seven types of skin cancers using the HAM10000 dataset. This dataset consists of diverse clinical images, providing a valuable resource for developing robust classification models. Our approach involves preprocessing the HAM10000 dataset to ensure data consistency and enhance model performance. We apply various machine learning models, including KNN, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Ridge Classifier, and SVM, to classify the different types of skin cancers. Through rigorous evaluation, our models demonstrate promising results. Among the models tested, the Random Forest algorithm exhibits superior performance, achieving a validation set accuracy of 95.5% and a test set accuracy of 95.6%. These results highlight the effectiveness of our proposed methodology in accurately classifying skin cancers and surpassing the performance of traditional detection procedures. By utilizing machine learning techniques, our solution offers an improved approach to skin cancer detection, addressing the limitations of existing methods. The integration of Random Forest further enhances accuracy, enabling early and accurate diagnosis, which is crucial for successful treatment outcomes and improved patient care.

articleTitle: Circuit Breaker: A Resilience Mechanism for Cloud Native Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Over the past decade, the utilization of cloud native applications has gained significant prominence, leading many organizations to swiftly transition towards developing software applications that leverage the powerful, accessible, and efficient cloud infrastructure. As these applications are deployed in distributed environments, there arises a need for reliable mechanisms to ensure their availability and dependability. Among these mechanisms, the circuit breaker pattern has emerged as a crucial element in constructing resilient and trustworthy cloud native applications in recent times. This research article presents a comprehensive review and analysis of circuit breaker patterns and their role within cloud-native applications. The study delves into various aspects of circuit breakers, encompassing their design, implementation, and recommended practices for their utilization in cloud native applications. Additionally, the article examines and compares different circuit breaker libraries available for employment in modern software development. The paper also presents a concept for improving the circuit breaker pattern, which will be pursued in our upcoming research.

articleTitle: Alzheimer Disease Detection System using AlexNet a novel Eight Layered Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD), an incurable brain ailment that is irreversible, affects thinking and memory while also shrinking the size of the mind as a whole. Alzheimer's is a neurological illness that causes severe memory loss and makes it difficult to carry out regular chores. The development of more effective treatments for AD depends on an early diagnosis of the condition. Finding Alzheimer's disease is a difficult and time-consuming task that requires a brain imaging report and competent people. This time-consuming and frequently inaccurate method of diagnosing Alzheimer's is traditional. There has been discussion of a different strategy that is quick, inexpensive, and more dependable. Better medical care and solutions can be provided with the use of artificial intelligence technologies. Due to distractions, technological flaws, cognitive biases, and weariness, human diagnosis performance suffers. However, AI-based diagnosis tools support physicians' safe detection and decision-making and are less prone to error. This study offers a clever and trustworthy method for identifying Alzheimer's disease and its potential early stage, moderate mental impairment. The given system accurately diagnoses Alzheimer's disease and its early stages from structural MRI images and is based on deep learning. The ability to predict whether patients with moderate cognitive impairment (MCI) may develop Alzheimer's disease is essential in clinical practice and has the potential to significantly improve clinical studies. To classify Alzheimer's disease and its prodromal stages, this initiative suggests combining MRI data with the Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE), a neuropsychological test.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Pear Tree Disease Detection: An In-Depth Investigation into CNN-Based Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: This research, used deep learning techniques, and a model for diagnosing diseases in pear plants is given in this study. For each of the ten different pear tree illnesses examined, the model exhibits remarkable precision, recall, and F1 scores. For instance, the F1-Score of 90.25%, precision of 91.53%, and recall of 89.01% respectively are used to identify the Rust disease. Other illnesses with high precision, recall, and F1 scores that routinely exceed 90% include Scab, Fire Blight, Leaf Spot, and brown Rot. This demonstrates the model's ability to recognize a variety of diseases under actual situations with accuracy and dependability. The solid overall performance of the model is reflected by the weighted average precision, recall, & F1-Score, all of which are 92.23%. Furthermore, the model successfully distinguishes between healthy and unhealthy pear trees, achieving an amazing total accuracy of 83.4%. This model provides a useful tool for the early detection of diseases in pear trees using a dataset of 9,216 photos, enhancing global food security and the long-term viability of pear farming. The model enables farmers, horticulturists as well and plant pathologists to take targeted actions to control and reduce disease outbreaks by providing accurate and timely disease identification. This could result in higher crop yields, lower losses, and improved sustainability for pear farming practices. With the help of this research, fruit tree cultivation and disease management will be improved, opening the way for more successful agricultural practices that will ultimately benefit both farmers and consumers.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Apple Orchard Health: CNNSVM Model for Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: A disease identification model's performance in apple farm disease management is evaluated in this study. The study targets five primary apple leaf diseases: Scab, Fire Blight, Cedar Rust, Powdery Mildew, and Leaf Spot. This study assesses the model's disease classification accuracy and reliability using advanced performance indicators. Each illness class has high precision values, 89.40% to 95.24 %. The model's precision scores show its capacity to limit false positives, proving its disease prediction accuracy. The model has outstanding recall rates of 90.91% to 93.65%, indicating its capacity to recognize all illness cases. The model's reliability and efficacy are reinforced by the F1-scores' balanced evaluation (91.47%–93.02%). Overall model accuracy of 92.19% is shown by strong cumulative findings across all illness classifications. The model's disease predictions are accurate across 6508 photos, proving its reliability. The model's micro-average performance of 92.19% shows its ability to generalize and identify diseases in varied situations. The model's consistent performance across all illness classes is shown by macro-averaged precision (92.47%), recall (92.09%), & F1-score (92.26%). The model's precision (92.26%), recall (92.19%), & F1-score (92.20%) weighted average values demonstrate its accuracy when class distribution changes.

articleTitle: Augmented/Virtual Reality: Technological Advancement with Use Cases
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Augmented reality (AR) technology gives real and computerized elements that appear to coexist in real space. It makes users feel all three senses: smelling, hearing, and touch of the human body. Virtual reality (VR) is technology comprising interactive computer simulations that create the impression of being completely or partially immersed. It is a strong human-computer interface that merges computer animation, image analysis, pattern identification, artificial intelligence, networking, and other technologies. This paper provides an overview of VR and AR technologies. It highlights tracking, interaction techniques, and display technology as key AR technologies, whereas immersive, semi-immersive, and non-immersive are the leading technologies of VR. It discusses the various use cases of VR and AR.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Share Price Prediction and Trend Direction Using Sentiment Analysis of Financial News Articles
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Stock price prediction is an area of current research due to the intricate data structure and many contributing elements. Many modern financial applications incorporate nonlinear and unpredictable components that exhibit temporal variability. The demand for solutions to highly nonlinear and time-dependent situations has experienced a significant increase in recent years. External variables such as public opinion and political events might impact the stock market. The main aim of this study is to examine the impact of investor mood on the market valuation of particular corporations. A machine learning model must consider emotional and contextual information in the first stages. The objective of this study is to analyze the influence of public opinion on the accuracy of algorithms in generating projections over 30 days. Furthermore, regression models are utilized to examine the interconnections across different organizations. The researchers obtained stock market data for their experiments from reliable sources, including the National Stock Exchange of India and the "Economic Times." The inquiry utilized the previously listed sources to gather monetary and public opinion statistics data. Both emotional and contextual elements are produced using pre-processing algorithms on the unprocessed textual input. Ultimately, the aforementioned characteristics are integrated into the data set creation process. A total of eleven discrete machine learning algorithms are employed to categorize the responses of news consumers. The interdependence analysis within the same industry unveiled a moderately positive correlation between stock markets. The present study examines the merits and demerits of artificial neural networks and hybrid intelligence, which are well-recognized artificial intelligence methodologies, within the context of the financial sector. In summary, the results affirm the integration of ensemble methodologies into the repertoire of algorithms employed in a pioneering investigation of predicting stock market fluctuations.

articleTitle: Scalable Web Crawling: Harnessing the Power of Hadoop MapReduce in a Distributed Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: This paper demonstrates the implementation of Distributed Web Crawling using the Hadoop MapReduce framework on a distributed system where multiple Virtual Machines are connected through a master-slave relationship with the Hadoop MapReduce Framework as the underlay. Distributed web crawling optimizes data retrieval by involving multiple machines, leading to faster crawling, fault tolerance, and scalability. The proposed approach harnesses the strength of Hadoop MapReduce which is powerful in handling web data at scale for various applications, including search engine indexing, data mining, and large-scale analytics. Furthermore, this robust, scalable, and high-performance solution for gathering information from the vast World Wide Web enables deeper insights and broader applications within the realm of big data. A performance experiment demonstrates the model's efficiency compared to sequential crawling which reports a reduction in execution time ranging from 60 to 75%.

articleTitle: Underwater Image Classification using Efficient Fine-tuned DenseNet-121 with Image Albumentation and Adagrad Optimizer for Minimum Loss
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Underwater image classification is a difficult task due to the unique properties of underwater surroundings. We provide an effective and fine-tuned DenseNet-121 model for underwater picture classification in this paper. We use picture augmentation techniques and the Adagrad optimizer to minimize loss during training to improve the model’s performance. Our goal is to obtain high accuracy, minimal loss, and an excellent F1-score in the classification of underwater image categories. It employs a dataset underwater photographs of various marine species and objects. Our model is built on the DenseNet-121 architecture, which is noted for its efficiency and powerful feature extraction capabilities.The model accuracy achieved is an Accounting 97.76%, with a loss of only 0.07. Furthermore, the model has a strong F1-score of 94%, indicating its ability to properly balance precision and recall in classification tasks. These findings demonstrate the model’s ability to reliably classify underwater photos across several categories. The efficiency of combining the DenseNet-121 architecture, image augmentation techniques, and the Adagrad optimizer for underwater picture classification is demonstrated in this paper. The model’s high accuracy, minimal loss, and solid F1-score demonstrate its promise for use in marine research, environmental monitoring, and undersea exploration.

articleTitle: Skin Cancer Classification using A Hybrid Convolutional Neural Network with SVM Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Digital dermoscopy is commonly employed by dermatologists for the diagnosis of malignancy. Clinicians' recognition of tumor is not only highly subjective, but also highly dependent on their level of experience. The inherent inter-operator unevenness in the private processing of dermoscopy pictures calls for fully automated computer-aided diagnosis(CAD) methods. The fine-grained differences in the manifestation of these abrasions on the skin-surface make automated skin lesion classification difficult. In several different types of fine-grained object classifications, deep convolutional-neural-network(CNN) has demonstrated excellent reparability. In order to categorize dermoscopy pictures into benign or malignancy lesions, this research introduces two innovative hybrid CNN strategies that use a support-vector-machine (SVM) at the output layer. In order to classify data, the characteristics mined by the first &second CNN strategies are combined and supplied to the SVM. The suggested model's efficacy is measured against a reference set of labels provided from a dermatology specialist. In a study using CAD for skin disease categorization, the generated CNN-segmented image folder distinguished atopic dermatitis from nasty diseases and obstacles like mycosis fungoides, impetigo, and herpesvirus contagion with a sensitivity and specificity of around 98%. In comparison to the traditional CNN strategies, the proposed models performed better on the ISBI 2016 public dataset. Both of the proposed models, with an accuracy of 88.02% and 87.43%, outperformed the standard CNN models. Reduced reliance on physician annotation and enhanced CAD performance are both benefits of our CNN segmentation algorithm, which automatically removes lesions and segments images of the skin area across all image fields.

articleTitle: Retail Shelf Planning Using YOLO V8
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Retail shelf planning is critical in optimizing product placement and enhancing the overall shopping experience for customers while simultaneously addressing the challenge of reducing excess inventory that ties up capital. In recent years, the integration of image analytics techniques has brought about a transformative shift in retail shelf planning by offering automated, data-driven solutions.This paper presents a practical application of cutting-edge object detection techniques in the context of retail shelf management. Visual audits are conducted collaboratively by retail staff and representatives from Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) product companies whose products are stocked on these shelves, primarily identifying out-of-stock products. The central objective of this paper is to address the challenge of "Classify objects into recognized classes and count instances", a long-standing issue in the field. Successfully solving this problem has the potential to optimize operational efficiency by reallocating human resources to areas where their expertise surpasses that of machines. The You Only Look Once (YOLO) V8 nano model is employed and trained to detect two specific object classes relevant to the retail shelf environment in this study. The results showcase a mean Average Precision at 50% intersection over union (mAP50) of 0.871 across all object classes, while the mAP50-95 stands at 0.541, indicating robust object detection capabilities. This paper concludes with a forward-looking discussion of the future directions for this paper. It underscores the substantial impact that image analytics is poised to make in shaping the future landscape of retail shelf planning. The convergence of advanced technology and retail industry expertise promises to further optimize product availability and customer satisfaction while streamlining operational processes.

articleTitle: Privacy-Enhanced Federated Learning for Rare Genetic Disorder Classification with EHR
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Utilizing machine learning and deep learning for disease classification has gained widespread popularity, yet it encounters significant challenges. Rare genetic disorders pose a data scarcity issue, as individual hospitals often lack sufficient data for accurate modelling. Collaborative data aggregation for such rare diseases raises data privacy concerns. Additionally, complex domains like genetic disorders require multifaceted data, including family history, medication history, and medical records. To address these challenges, this research explores federated learning on electronic health records (EHR) for the classification of rare genetic disorders. The study employs a dataset with a diverse range of patient information and leverages neural networks in a federated learning setup. The results demonstrate a 6% improvement in accuracy compared to individual hospital models, highlighting the effectiveness of this approach. Furthermore, the study provides insights into the trade-off between accuracy and privacy, emphasizing the importance of federated learning in safeguarding patient data while enhancing disease classification accuracy in the context of rare genetic disorders.

articleTitle: Pollen Allergy Prediction: A Review of the Time-Frame-Specific Forecast Models
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Pollen allergies are an increasing global health concern, affecting millions of individuals worldwide. As climate change leads to continual increases in pollen levels, it is anticipated that the prevalence of pollen allergies will also rise. In light of the growing concern about rising pollen levels and their potential impact on public health, this study commences with a thorough exposition of the background concerning pollen allergies, highlighting the epidemiological trends, seasonal variations, and the impact on public health. It underscores the need for accurate and timely prediction models to mitigate the adverse effects of pollen exposure. The problem statement centers on the deficiencies observed in prevailing pollen prediction models frequently characterized by their inadequate precision and limited real-time adaptability. Moreover, these models are often geographically limited, making them unsuitable for widespread applicability. The proposed study envisions a future where advanced machine learning algorithms, coupled with remote sensing data and meteorological information, can enhance pollen allergy prediction accuracy. This approach aims to develop a comprehensive and adaptable system capable of forecasting pollen levels with greater precision and geographical coverage. This review paper also emphasizes the pressing need for improved pollen allergy prediction systems. It highlights the potential of cutting-edge technologies and data integration to revolutionize how we forecast pollen levels, ultimately aiding allergy sufferers in better managing their condition and healthcare providers in delivering more effective care.

articleTitle: From Paddy to Pixel: An In-depth Exploration into Classifying Diverse Rice Varieties Leveraging Advanced Convolutional Neural Network Architectures
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Rice, one of the most extensively cultivated grain commodities globally, has a diverse range of genetic variations. These different types are distinguished from one another based on specific characteristics they possess. By utilizing the distinguishing characteristics of rice types, it becomes feasible to categorize and assess the standard of seeds. Rice varieties need to be distinguished for several reasons. Like, every type has different requirements for water, nutrients in the soil, and resistance to diseases and pests. Accurate rice variety identification allows farmers to implement specialized agronomic techniques that increase production and reduce resource waste and different varieties of rice satisfy different consumer preferences. For this reason, this research has proposed a Convolutional Neural Network framework to classify different varieties of rice. The dataset used in this study consisted of 75,000 photos, which were obtained from the comprehensive Rice Image Dataset. These images represented five different rice varieties. The initial findings demonstrate a notable level of high accuracy in classification of 98.88%, indicating the practicality and resilience of the methodology implemented. The model has achieved an average precision of 97% and an f-1 score of 0.97. Acquiring such knowledge will enable individuals to make well-informed decisions about cultivation, harvest, post-harvest processing, and market dynamics, thereby enhancing agricultural efficiency.

articleTitle: Question Answering Systems Employing Artificial Intelligence Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Nowadays, the majority of users try to move in the right direction for information that is available over the internet. A question-answering system that can grasp the user’s natural language query and offer a prompt, accurate response is therefore necessary. In this paper, question answering system that employs a variety of approaches, namely a QA system has been reviewed that provides responses for a variety of question kinds and on a domain basis. In addition to this, the study draws attention to the gaps that were found in the previously published research. Reviewing the different working systems in the medical sector, namely HONQA, EAGLi, and askHERMES, revealed that HONQA delivers a one-line solution for the inquiry, however with EAGLi, we need to validate the answer that was provided by it. askHERMES provides an answer that is needed to be validated. In the healthcare industry, the askHERMES question and answer platform is by far the most popular and widely used option.
