This accounts for the variations in power production, inverter capacity, and distance between DG and PCC.

articleTitle: Utilizing Hybrid CNN Model and Machine Learning Techniques for the Identification of Pulmonary Fibrosis
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Pulmonary fibrosis is a progressive lung disorder characterized by scar tissue formation, leading to a deterioration of the patient’s respiratory function. The identification of such diseases heavily relies on medical imaging techniques, such as high-resolution computed tomography (HRCT) and radiographic images (X-rays). Unfortunately, the high cost and potential risks associated with radiation exposure make HRCT inaccessible to the majority of people. This paper proposes a hybrid model for classifying fibrotic and healthy lungs from chest X-ray images. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have emerged as the most widely used deep learning models for medical image classification. However, different CNN architectures employ distinct approaches to learning and interpreting images. So, the features of three well-known CNNs: Xception, InceptionResnetV2, and DenseNet121, are fused to form a comprehensive feature representation. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is applied to alleviate overfitting and reduce dimensionality. Subsequently, a random forest classifier is employed on the principal components for accurate classification. By integrating these methods, we aim to enhance the classification of pulmonary fibrosis and promote early detection for improved patient outcomes.

articleTitle: A Sophisticated Method for X-Ray Image-Based Knee Osteoarthritis Diagnosis Utilising Moblienetv3 Large
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: A common deteriorating joint condition that impacts millions of individuals worldwide is osteoarthritis. For optimal care and avoidance of its development, early and accurate identification is essential. Algorithms utilizing deep learning are currently showing promising outcomes in medical image analysis applications, such as disease categorization. Through the use of the MobileNetV3 architecture, a compact and effective convolutional neural network (CNN) created for deployment on devices with limited resources, such as smartphones, this study proposes a unique method for the categorization of knee osteoarthritis. The suggested approach entails building a deep learning model using MobileNetV3 and assembling a sizable dataset of knee X-ray images containing both knee osteoarthritic and healthy patients. To achieve accurate and trustworthy ground truth labeling, the dataset is tweaked and marked by qualified radiologists.

articleTitle: Div-Df: A Diverse Manipulation Deepfake Video Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Recent advances in image and video manipulation have given rise to grave concerns. Deepfake technology employs deep learning techniques to produce astoundingly lifelike content. Deepfakes are risky since they have the ability to counterfeit someone’s identity by replacing their face with that of another person or generating random noise in the mouth area. Additionally, with just a few seconds of audio, AI-based deep learning models can replicate any person’s voice. Detecting such videos is the only promising defense against such fraudulent data. Several deepfake datasets have been made available to help in deepfake detector training and testing, including DF-TIMIT [1], FaceForensics++ [2], Celeb-DF [3], DFDC [4], Deeperforensics1.0 [5], etc. Even though this has significantly improved deepfake detection methods, they are still unable to capture real-world scenarios entirely, as most of the dataset is face-swap manipulation. To bridge this gap, we have proposed a Div-DF dataset containing various types of video manipulation like face swap, facial reenactment, and lip-sync. This dataset is composed of 150 real videos of different celebrities of different professions and 250 deepfake videos (100 face-swap videos, 100 facial reenactment videos, and 50 lip-sync videos). Deepfake videos are synthesized using state-of-the-art Face-Swap GAN(FSGAN) and the Wav2Lip method. The dataset contains high-quality samples of face-swapped and lip-sync videos, while the samples of face-re-enactment are of average quality. We have tested state-of-the-art detection and image classification models to standardize our dataset’s baseline evaluation of various detection methods. We have done a comprehensive assessment along different metrics and found that our dataset is challenging and represents real-world samples.

articleTitle: Research on Visualization Method of Automotive A- Pillar Blind Zone Based on 3D Reconstruction and Perspective Transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Today's rapid development of science and technology, transportation is also diverse, of which the car is an indispensable one, followed by the emphasis on driving safety, car A-pillar can be in the car collision, good protection of the safety of the cab, from which the theory is that the thicker the A-pillar, the higher the safety. However, the thicker the A-pillar will produce blind zone occlusion, resulting in great safety hazards, and traditional observation methods are not enough to solve the safety hazards of A-pillar blind zone occlusion. Therefore, this paper proposes a visualization of automotive A-pillar blind zone based on three-dimensional reconstruction and perspective transformation, and performs visual analysis of A-pillar blind zone. Firstly, the computer is used to visually analyze the A-pillar blind zone, and the indicators are carried out according to the visual requirements of the A-pillar blind zone Divide and reduce interference factors in the blind zone of the A-pillar. Then, the computer evaluates the driving safety of the car to form a visual scheme for the A-pillar blind spot, and the A-pillar blind zone is visible The results were comprehensively analyzed. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the blind zone of automobile A-pillar based on three-dimensional reconstruction and perspective transformation is visualized to car A The visual feasibility of column blind zone and the visual optimization time of A-column blind zone are better than traditional observation methods.

Author Keywords: Visualization of automotive A-pillar blind spot based on 3D reconstruction and perspective transformation

articleTitle: Detection of Hazardous gases using Deep Learning on Benchmark Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The leakage of gas emission is a most critical aspect to be considered in House appliances, Industries, Coal Mines, Transportation, etc. Leakage of gas identification at early stage is more important to avoid harmful to human beings and environment. Sensors are used to detect these hazardous gases. Low-cost sensors are less in both sensitivity and reliability to detect the gases from farther distances. In this paper Bi-LSTM model with parameter tuning is applied on publicly available dataset and obtained an accuracy of 93.5%, 92% of sensitivity, and 95% specificity with the public dataset.

articleTitle: Cleanliness Follow-up using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Garbage collection is a challenging task which require tremendous efforts and manpower. This research proposes automatic garbage collection system with the help of the CCTV cameras present on the street. The proposed work includes generation of handcrafted dataset having images of garbage piles as per requirement. Deep Learning models viz. YOLOv5n, YOLOv7-tiny and YOLOv8n are employed to form a system which detects the garbage and send alert to the relevant authorities.

articleTitle: Passive Cell Equalization & State of Charge Estimation Using Coulomb Counting Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The veracity of a battery model and SOC estimation has a profound impact on the control strategy of a vehicle management system and electric vehicle performance, which is critical for efficient battery management and increasing vehicle reliability.The intent of this project is to extend battery longevity through cell balancing, which is instrumental in preserving battery life.This paper examines the merits and drawbacks of various SOC estimation techniques, as well as the principles, analysis of battery pack in MATLAB/ Simulink, implementation of Coulomb Counting Method and research progress of SoC estimation algorithms and passive cell balancing, with the goal of providing references for future researchers.

articleTitle: Improved Algorithm of Line Loss of Distribution Network Under Asymmetric Heterogeneous Load
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The role of three-phase asymmetric load in the distribution network is very important, but there is a problem that the loss of power in the network transmission is relatively large. The existing adjacency matrix method cannot solve the problem of three-phase asymmetric load in the distribution network, and the evaluation is unreasonable. Therefore, a line loss improvement algorithm is proposed to optimize the three-phase asymmetric load analysis. The indicators are divided according to the three-phase asymmetric load requirements to reduce them Interference factors in three-phase asymmetric loads. Then, the power theory optimizes the three-phase asymmetric load to form a three-phase asymmetric load scheme, and the three-phase asymmetric load results are carried out Comprehensive analysis. the line loss improvement algorithm optimizes the line loss, power quality and resistance of three-phase asymmetric load Higher than the adjacency matrix method.

articleTitle: Disease Recognition in Broccoli: Enhancing Crop Health and Productivity
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Because of its high nutritional value and contributions to global food security, broccoli is a crucial crop. However, a number of illnesses can affect its cultivation and have a substantial impact on quality and yield. We offer a unique method for broccoli disease identification utilising a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) model to handle this problem. While the SVM makes the final illness classification, the CNN retrieves key information from leaf pictures. Our model’s overall accuracy was 83.213% after it was trained and tested on a wide range of broccoli leaf image datasets. The outcomes show how well the combined CNN-SVM model performs in distinguishing between damaged and healthy broccoli leaves. By providing a useful tool for early disease diagnosis and efficient crop management in broccoli growing, this research advances precision agriculture.

articleTitle: Implementation of Efficient Carry Select Adder Using 45nm Technology in Cadence Tool
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Adders serve as fundamental components in digital integrated circuit design, finding widespread use. Among traditional adder structures, the Carry Select Adder (CSA) stands out for its rapid operation. As the mobile industry expands swiftly, there is a demand not only for faster arithmetic units but also for arithmetic units that occupy less space and consume lower power. The Carry-Select approach strikes a favorable balance between cost and performance in designing adders with carry propagation. Nonetheless, the conventional CSA design still incurs a notable area overhead due to its utilization of dual ripple carry adders (RCA). To address this, a modified CSA architecture has been developed, leveraging a Binary to Excess-1 code converter (BE-1 converter). This research introduces an effective technique involving gate-level modifications within the BE-1 converter design to significantly curtail the area and power footprint of the CSA. Leveraging this modification, 4-bit CSA architecture using BE-1 converter is devised and compared against the standard CSA design. The assessment of these designs takes into account their area and power characteristics. The analytical results highlight the superiority of the proposed CSA structure over the conventional one, demonstrating that the use of a CSA employing a BE-1 converter holds efficiency for VLSI implementation.

articleTitle: Elevating EV Performance: Multilevel Inverter Solutions for IPMSM Drive
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) are one of the finest alternatives to traditional IC engines in the current market scenario. Motors are an inevitable part of the traction system used in EVs. Due to their appreciable energy economy, dependable operation, and high power density, interior permanent magnet synchronous motors (IPMSM) are increasingly being used in modern EVs. One of the major objectives in the contemporary automotive business is to obtain a smooth driving pattern in an electric vehicle by reducing the ripples in the motor. As a possible solution, this paper proposes a close-loop control of the IPMSM motor being fed from multilevel inverters to suppress the ripples produced. Using MATLAB/Simulink, a mathematical model of a multilevel voltage source inverter and an IPMSM plant model was created to conduct the study. Inverters with output voltage levels of two, three, and five levels have been modeled for comparison of speed, torque ripples, and current harmonics produced by the motor. According to simulation studies, multi-level inverters perform better than traditional two-level inverters, making them suitable for EV applications.

articleTitle: Analysis of Solar Parabolic Trough Concentrator Thermal Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: An effective parabolic trough solar energy concentrator receiver is the topic of discussion in this work, which presents a thermal analysis of such a receiver. Although there are a variety of stages of development for concentrating solar technologies, the majority of these technologies have made it through the testing phases and are now available on the commercial market. Because of its ability to focus the sun’s rays on a small area, the parabolic trough shape is often used to create solar collectors which is considered to be the most suitable design for a solar collector. Concentrated solar power is used by the parabolic solar system. This kind of solar power makes use of reflectors and monitoring systems to bring a large amount of sunlight into a limited region, which then provides adequate thermal heat. The thermal behaviour of the receiver is performed for a variety of geometrical factors, such as the ratio of the fin aspect to the total thickness of the fins, as well as for porosity. This is done for a variety of heat flux situations.

articleTitle: Sentiment analysis of reviews using Nature Inspired PSO and ANN
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Social media now plays an important role is sharing the views or comments about a topic. These comments are available to the users for their processing and future decision making process. As the reviews contains mostly text or emojis, thus, processing is required to obtained the required information. Nature is always a source for inspiration and knowledge.The activities of the nature can act as a source for optimization and classification. In this paper, two nature inspired algorithms are considered for analysis. Firstly, Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) act as an optimization technique for feature selection i.e., best features are selected and these best features act as input to Artificial Neural Network (ANN) for further classification purpose. The reviews are processed using the proposed algorithms and finally, the confusion matrix is generated, which helps to generate the evaluation parameters to evaluate the results.

articleTitle: Identification of Osteoporosis In X-Ray Images Using CNN and SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Osteoporosis, a complex skeletal ailment primarily observed in postmenopausal women, is characterized by the degradation of bone tissue and low bone mineral density. Detecting this condition early is crucial to mitigate the heightened risk of fractures. To address this, a novel framework has been proposed, combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Support Vector Machines (SVMs). This framework aims to enhance the accuracy of osteoporosis detection using X-ray scans. The initial phase involves a pretrained CNN model, possibly VGG16, recognized for its prowess in discerning intricate image features. The X-ray images, vital for diagnosis, undergo preprocessing to conform to the CNN’s prerequisites, encompassing resizing and normalization. This pretrained CNN effectively learns to extract significant patterns from the images, capturing nuances in bone density and structure. The ensuing stage employs an SVM classifier, which capitalizes on the extracted features as input. SVMs are adept at classifying data points, and in this context, they discern between osteoporotic and non-osteoporotic images. By seeking an optimal separation between these two classes within the feature space, the SVM facilitates accurate classification. Notably, this proposed framework stands out by potentially surpassing preceding methodologies reliant solely on pretrained CNNs. The fusion of CNNs and SVMs augments accuracy by adeptly encapsulating image intricacies and translating them into informed diagnostic conclusions. As a result, the framework contributes to more precise and timely identification of osteoporosis, thereby addressing a critical healthcare challenge.

articleTitle: Recognition of Human Emotions Through The Use of Facial Expressions
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Emotions play a pivotal role in human life, influencing communication, relationships, and productivity. Recognizing and understanding these emotions is crucial, and various methods have been explored, including monitoring brain activity. However, traditional approaches, such as electroencephalography (EEG), are costly and time-consuming, often yielding accuracy rates ranging from 31% to 81%. In this study, we propose an alternative approach: accurately detecting human emotions through facial expressions. Leveraging an existing simulator and neural networks, we achieved remarkable accuracy rates of up to 96%. We present the methodology, including image processing, differential readings, and facial expression detection, and compare our approach to other methods. The study sheds light on the potential of neural network-based systems for high-accuracy emotion recognition from facial expressions, offering a promising avenue for human-computer interaction and intelligent surveillance systems.

articleTitle: Analysis of Accurate Investment Strategy of Distribution Network Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Nowadays, with the development of society, people need more and more energy for life, so all walks of life are also improving facilities and equipment, one of the most indispensable energy sources is electricity. Power supply companies have also been continuously improving the construction of the main network in recent years, and in the development of the future power grid, the construction of the distribution network is also a part that cannot be ignored. Therefore, the precise investment in the distribution network should be paid attention to. Traditional investment strategies cannot solve the problem of whether precise investment in distribution networks is feasible and reasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes an ant colony algorithm to analyze the accurate investment of distribution network. First, the computer is used to analyze and evaluate the investment strategy, and the indicators are divided according to the precise investment requirements of the distribution network to reduce it Interference factors in precise investment in distribution networks. Then, the computer evaluates the precise investment strategy of the distribution network, forms the precise investment plan of the distribution network, and conducts the precise investment results of the distribution network Comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows the rationality of the ant colony algorithm for accurate investment in distribution network under certain evaluation criteria The feasibility of precise investment in distribution network is better than that of traditional investment strategies.

articleTitle: UAV 3D Path Planning based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Path planning technology is the core part of UAV field, the purpose of path planning is to provide a feasible and safe optimal path for UAV flight, to meet the feasibility of UAV operation, and improve the path optimization ability of UAV in complex and multi-obstacle environment. Traditional path planning algorithms have low computational efficiency and are prone to local extremes. In this paper, it is proposed that the three-dimensional path planning of UAV based on ant colony algorithm can improve the effectiveness of UAV dynamic constraint processing and enhance the path optimization ability in multi-obstacle environment. The advantages of this algorithm are fast convergence speed, simple calculation process, and few parameters, etc., and it has become the first choice for UAV planning three-dimensional path. At the same time, a multi-obstacle model is constructed in a three-dimensional environment, and the fitness function is constructed on the obstacle threat, path length and navigation height integration. After dynamic 3D environment simulation experiments, the results show that the ant colony algorithm can significantly improve the UAV path optimization ability and ensure the stability of 3D path planning.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms to the Prediction of Stock Market Trends
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The stock market's inherent volatility poses ongoing challenges for stock traders, as it is subject to a multitude of circumstances that exert influence on its behavior. This research aims to mitigate the risk associated with forecasting stock market trends through the utilization of deep learning and machine learning techniques. Eleven machine learning models were utilized in this study: random forest, logistic regression, xgboost, naive Bayes, K-nearest neighbors, decision tree and support vector classifier and extreme gradient boosting. Additionally, two powerful deep learning techniques: recurrent neural networks (RNN) and long short term memory (LSTM) were used. From the Tehran Stock Exchange, four market groups were chosen for the experimental estimates. Petroleum, non-metallic minerals, basic metals, and diversified financials are all part of these categories.

articleTitle: Design of 8-bit Low power & High performance SAR ADC using current steering DAC
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: A novel approach of 8-bit low power & high performance Successive Approximation analog to digital converter consumes a large amount of power. As compared to other Analog to Digital Converter, Successive Approximation Register Analog to Digital Converters (SAR ADC) are cheaper because of their compact circuitry. In digital to analog modules, high power dissipation has been observed. To achieve excellent power efficiency with relatively moderate resolution, modifications are proposed to Digital to Analog Converter (DAC) architecture. With its current steering digital to analog converter, this SAR ADC will be useful for low power applications with high speed and medium resolution. The ADC is designed in 90nm CMOS technology. In this thesis, 8-bit SAR ADC firstly designed in 90nm technology and comparing power consumption and delay with 45nm technology. Schematics designed using Cadence Virtuoso Tool. Circuit designs for these logics use 1V to 2.5V power supplies to operate the transistors in saturation region. To reduce power consumption, a low-power comparator is designed. The SAR ADC is chosen as it is low-power, and has a small die size compared to other types of ADCs. This allowed for a powerefficient design.

articleTitle: Advancements in Semantic Skin Lesion Segmentation: A Comparative Study with YOLOv8 for Accurate Skin Lesion Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Acquiring labeled data for multi-type skin lesions poses a significant challenge due to the high cost associated with the involvement of dermatologists, given the intricate nature of small pixel variations and irregularly shaped lesion characteristics. Moreover, the presence of multiple types of skin lesions exhibiting these characteristics often leads to overlapping or nearby occurrences, further complicating the labeling process. Numerous models have been developed to accurately segment identified pixels in skin lesion datasets, with a focus on semantic segmentation and instance-based segmentation approaches. This paper aims to compare the most effective semantic segmentation techniques with the recently introduced YOLO V8 model, evaluating their performance and suitability for accurately segmenting skin lesions. Due to its superior mean average precisions (mAPs) and faster inference speed on the COCO dataset, YOLOv8 is considered the new state-of-the-art model, making it a promising candidate for accurate skin lesion segmentation.

articleTitle: A Distribution Network State Estimation Model Constructed Based On 5G Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: With the increasing demand for electricity, in order to cope with today's climate change and sustainable energy development, the distribution network is also driven to change. Traditional distribution network state technology can no longer meet the changes in the current distribution network status requirements. Therefore, this paper proposes an active distribution network status technology for distribution network analysis. First, the computer is used to analyze and evaluate the status of the distribution network, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of the distribution network to reduce the distribution network in the interfering factor. Then, the computer analyzes the status of the power system distribution network to form the distribution network scheme and conducts the distribution network results Comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the active distribution network state technology estimates the distribution network status of thepower system Reliability and distribution network optimization are superior to traditional distribution network status technologies.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of Arc Furnaces
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Mathematical modeling of arc furnaces plays a crucial role in understanding and optimizing their operation. Arc furnaces are widely used in various industries such as steel making, for melting and refining processes. This paper presents an overview of the mathematical modeling techniques employed to simulate and analyze arc furnaces. This model is designed for developing control strategies for arc furnaces. By incorporating real-time data from sensors and feedback mechanisms into the model, engineers can create predictive control algorithms that optimize furnace performance, maintain desired operating conditions and respond to disturbances in the process.

articleTitle: Comparison of Targeted and Predicted Down-Link Channels using Deep Learning Techniques for Massive MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Predicting and estimating the channels in mm-Wave systems using Deep-Learning is more reliable. This powerful tool enables the scaling up of the number of antennas at the receiver as well as at the transmitter side with minimum pilot sequence length. In this paper, estimation of predicted channels in massive MIMO systems with 1-bit ADCs are carried out using a deep learning-based approach. Channel estimation is done across various numbers of base station antennas with different pilot sequence lengths. In this system, the received quantized values are used for mapping the channels which are learned by utilizing deep neural networks and prior channel estimation observations. The downlink channels are estimated by using the channel-to-channel mapping concept. This concept exists if and only if the bijectiveness function is satisfied, even if it is satisfied, it is extremely difficult to analyze the channel mapping due to many dependencies on the surrounding multipath environment. Channel-to-channel mapping eliminates the downlink training. Simulations are carried out for different pilot sequence lengths (2, 5, 7, 10, and 20) with base station antennas ranging from 2 to 100. From the results, an interesting observation is made i.e., when the number of base station antennas is increased, then the required pilot sequence length becomes small. This channel mapping can also be used in MIMO radar systems, massive MIMO-based positioning systems, broadband systems with frequency-selective channels, reflecting intelligent systems and mm-Wave beam predictions.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Duplicate Data Management Level based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The role of duplicate data management in data management is important, but there is a problem of inaccurate outcome evaluation. Traditional machine algorithms cannot solve the problem of duplicate data management in data management, and the evaluation is unreasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes a deep learning algorithm for repetitive data management analysis in data management. Firstly, the the duplicate data, and the indicators are divided according to the data management requirements to reduce the management of duplicate data Disturbing factors in. to manage duplicate data in data management, form a duplicate data management scheme, and manage the results of duplicate data Conduct a comprehensive analysis. Sim Manager simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, deep learning algorithms manage data The accuracy of duplicate data management and the time of duplicate data management are better than traditional machine algorithms.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Anti-Tremor Wearable Band for Parkinson’s Patients
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The medical industry is currently utilizing a significant number of automated tools. This study offers a module that helps to prototype an anti-tremor medication module, in which the hardware is reviewed by observing conventional vibrations through the motor. Parkinson's disease is caused by a loss of nerve cells in a part of the brain called the substantia nigra. Most people diagnosed with Parkinson's disease are age 60 years or older, however, an estimated 5 to 10 percent of people with. It is possible to determine a person's hand tremors. The ADXL335 accelerometer communicates over the I2C protocol, which can be implemented using the ATtiny85's hardware I2C module or by bit-banging the I2C protocol using GPIO pins. Once the accelerometer is set up and configured, it can provide acceleration data in real-time that can be used to trigger the vibration motor. ADXL335 accelerometer sensor as an apparatus for detecting tremors. The ADXL335 accelerometer circuit is straightforward, with no complex parts or wiring required. It connects to an Arduino and ATtiny 85 directly through analog pins. The wide range of wearable gadgets increases the variety of their applications. With the introduction of wearable technologies capable of processing and storing vast volumes of a person's health data, continuous monitoring of the human body is becoming more widespread. The antitremor wearable band makes the person aware of the tremor by the vibration and gets stability when the tremor occurs. The vibration motor changes its duty cycle within the range of 0- 100% which is proportional to accelerometer values ranging from 0g-2g(1g = 9.80665m/s2) ADXL335 detects various tremor stages, and they are stabilized through a vibration motor and so the model is tested.

articleTitle: Investigating Artificial Intelligence-based Solution for Protecting Online Gaming Servers Against Anomalies
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The proliferation of affordable mobile phones and computers has led to an increasing prevalence of individuals engaging in game-playing activities. This trend has been particularly pronounced in the realm of online gaming, with a notable surge seen over the last decade. The consumers have a preference for engaging in sophisticated gaming experiences inside virtual environments. Numerous firms are offering their services in this particular domain. With the escalating competitiveness, gaming service firms are susceptible to being attacked by hackers for various malicious activities such as ransomware attacks and data theft. It is important to implement measures to safeguard the gaming web server from potential assaults in order to provide customers with a secure environment for uninterrupted access to gaming services. This study presents a machine learning-driven approach to identify the genuineness of communication at an early stage. The proposed model utilizes a pre-trained algorithm to assess whether incoming data packets are malicious or benign. The proposed framework is evaluated by applying it to anomalies in a web server dataset, using classification machine learning methods. The obtained results are then compared based on several metrics like accuracy, F1 score, ROC Curve, and precision. The use of sophisticated machine learning models such as Random Forest, Decision Tree, and Gaussian NaiveBayes has yielded valuable insights pertaining to the detection of abnormalities, atypical patterns, and deviations from expected behavior inside gaming server ecosystems.

articleTitle: Research on Network Accounting Information Security based on AES Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The role of information security in network accounting is very important, but there is a problem of inaccurate outcome evaluation. The one-way hash encryption algorithm cannot solve the information security problem in network accounting, and the evaluation is unreasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes an AES algorithm for network accounting information security analysis. First, the business operation theory is used to integrate the data, and the indicators are divided according to the information security requirements to reduce network accounting information's security in the interfering factor. Then, the business operation theory is used to form a network accounting scheme and synthesize the AES algorithm analysis results. MBAZ shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the AES algorithm is safe for the accounting information of network accounting the accuracy and time are better than the one-way hash encryption algorithm.

articleTitle: An Effective Adaptive Fuzzy Filter for SAR Image Noise Reduction
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In this paper, I propose a fuzzy logic methodology for the problem of uncertainty in an innovative manner. The foundation of this strategy is synthetic aperture radar, which can provide high-resolution images in any conditions, day or night. Speckle noise, which is produced by the random interference of EM signals disseminated by the object's plane within one resolution group, distorts the SAR images, but application scientists have widely accepted and utilized them. It is impossible to predict how much visual cacophony will appear or where its concentration will be. The quantitative nature of the majority of extant noise filters disqualifies them for use with uncertain data. According to this study, non-sub sampling filter banks may effect the transform's directionality, anisotropy, and translation invariance. This filter has been demonstrated to effectively reduce noise while preserving image edge quality.

articleTitle: Securing Intellectual Property in the Digital Age through Blockchain Innovation
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The digital age has ushered in unprecedented challenges in the protection of intellectual property (IP) across various industries. Traditional methods of safeguarding creative works and innovations struggle to address the complexities posed by digital reproduction and distribution. This research paper explores a promising solution to these challenges by investigating the integration of blockchain technology into the realm of IP protection. Blockchain's foundational characteristics of decentralization, immutability, and transparency offer a unique framework to revolutionize the way IP is secured and managed. By leveraging blockchain's tamper-proof distributed ledger, a new paradigm emerges where provenance, ownership, and usage rights of creative assets can be seamlessly recorded and tracked. This research delves into the technical mechanisms that underpin this innovation, including digital signatures, hash functions, and smart contracts, to establish a comprehensive understanding of how blockchain can enhance IP protection. Privacy and data protection are critical aspects when integrating blockchain into IP protection mechanisms. This research navigates the delicate balance between transparency and privacy, exploring strategies to safeguard sensitive IP information while preserving the benefits of blockchain's auditable nature.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Controller-Based Grid Interfaced Solar Water Pump Using SRM
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The goal of this research is to develop a PV control system-based switching reluctance motor-based standalone solar water pumping system. Due to their practicality, which has its own precedent, photovoltaic systems are significant as ecologically beneficial energy sources. However, there are some challenges to take into account. The most practical and successful solution is to automatically monitor the sun. Solar radiation and the surrounding environment have an impact on the voltage, current, and power characteristics of PV modules, which in turn dictate their performance. A controller is therefore necessary to minimise impact and maximise the output of a PV array. For surveillance, a variety of fuzzy inference techniques are used, and the current system for obtaining water using photovoltaic panels has drawn a lot of interest. In the current issue, a switching reluctance motor is used with the utility grid. SRM has a considerable advantage over the majority of other engines. The popularity of matrix systems is rising as a result of their dependability, accuracy, and toughness. Due to the tremendous advancements in solar technology, a straightforward control system and design for a PV-powered switched reluctance engine for cranking workloads were created using MATLAB modelling.

articleTitle: Research on Transfer Characteristics of Capacitive Voltage Transformer based on PRONY Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Capacitive voltage transformer is the main equipment for monitoring the voltage of substation, integrating voltage transformation, voltage division, measurement, protection, measurement and coupled carrier functions, the higher the grade, the higher the fundamental measurement accuracy, stronger insulation reliability, more ideal transient response characteristics, smaller maintenance workload and stronger economy. At the same time, it can be used as a coupling capacitor in wire carrier communication, becoming the first choice for high-voltage substations. In order to better study the transfer characteristics of capacitive voltage transformers, the PRONY algorithm is introduced in this paper. The results show that the capacitive voltage transformer can accurately measure the fundamental voltage signal, the voltage signal conversion accuracy is high, which meets the national measurement requirements, and the accuracy of the measurement result is less affected by the frequency change. When some frequency transformers have a large transformation ratio, the transient voltage signal error and harmonic measurement error will be increased, and the transmission characteristics of capacitive voltage transformers can be effectively improved after using this algorithm.

articleTitle: Five Layered Mask-RCNN based Dental Disease Detection from Children Panoramic Radiographs
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Dentists typically use their naked senses to diagnose oral diseases, however this method presents numerous potential for misinterpretation and incorrect evaluations. The periodontal illness identification assistance platform based on advanced learning algorithm is created for increasing the precision and performance of the diagnosis of dental disorders. The technology could be extending its service that can autonomously recognize the dental images gathered by the recording device that aids the dentist with the diagnosis. This paper suggests Five Layered Mask-RCNN (FLM-RCNN) to diagnose the children dental disease from the Panoramic Radiograph images. The proposed model uses Children's Dental Panoramic Radiographs Dataset from Kaggle that consists of 1000 dental images. The FLM-RCNN model initiates with exploration of image distribution. The dental images are fitted with Mask RCNN model that performs the segmentation, selecting the ROI region and performs the bounding box regression for prediction of children dental disease. The existing Mask-RCNN is fitted with dental images by varying the number of convolutional layers. The dental images are applied to FLM-RCNN which is designed with five convolutional layers and the same images are fitted with Mask-RCNN with 2, 3, 4, 6 and 7 convolutional layers. The experimental results explores that the recommended FLM-RCNN with five convolutional layer exhibits highest Accuracy of 98.42 when examined against other convolutional layers.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Deep Learning Algorithm in Face Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Recognition technology is a kind of extensive technology applied by AI technology, which mainly uses expressions and related data for face recognition. The key points in face recognition technology need intelligent algorithm analysis.Therefore, this paper proposes an intelligent technology of face recognition, which analyzes its expressions. First, collect expression data, then compare expressions according to expression formats and samples, and carry out the actual situation.Face recognition can find the actual expressions of different people and make judgments based on them. The research results show that face recognition can better analyze actions and expressions, and provide technology for related research.Face recognition technology can be widely used.

articleTitle: Website Traffic Trends and Performance Evaluation of Selected Consumer Electronic Company Websites
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Consumer Electronics are devices which are needed by everyone for everyday use. Globally, Indian consumer electronics and appliances industry is at $9.84 Billion by 2021 and is predicted to reach $21.18 Billion by 2025(www.ibef.org). Refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners, and smartphones are the major products of the consumer electronics industry. The annual consumer electronics sales are growing rapidly, one of the main driving forces behind the growth of consumer electronic industry is awareness through social media platforms. There are many brands which are intensively using social media marketing to reach the mass consumers and to reach target audiences easily. Companies are constantly using many vigorous promotional efforts to attract the target audience. The present study tries to compare and evaluate the various consumer electronics company’s website analytics to evaluate famous brands using SEMrush analytics software. The present study has taken count of unique visitors, rate of bounce, average duration most frequently visited pages, click through rate, backlink and referring domain to measure the performance of the consumer electronic websites and proposes strategies to improve the quality of the websites and traffics. The study also applies very popular sales promotion framework proposed by St. Elmo Lewis, AIDA model in marketing to measure the promotional efforts of some consumer electronic brands.

articleTitle: Art of Rare Pattern Discovery Techniques in Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In the current era, data analysis has become an integral part of decision-making processes. Data is collected from various sources, such as cloud warehouses, for decision-making and subjected to different classifications and data mining algorithms. One of the most crucial tasks in data mining is rare item set mining, which employs different association-based techniques and threshold values to uncover hidden data in the form of patterns. The research paper provides a comprehensive overview of the latest rare pattern mining techniques and their applications, which can be highly beneficial in achieving efficient and effective decision-making processes.

articleTitle: Implementation of Demand Side Management Using PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In the present-day scenario, the management of grids plays a vital role. Demand-side management here acts as an important tool in developing trends. to meet the total power demand during peak loads, like reducing the total power demand in those situations. This paper focuses on the optimization of load consumption curves in smart grids using load-shifting techniques. And also, this paper discusses the optimization of load consumption through a PSO algorithmic approach, which in turn focuses on day-ahead load schedules concerning DSM, which is responsible for a low cost.

articleTitle: Detecting Epileptic Seizures from iEEG with Spectral Envelope Analysis and Deep CNNs
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Epilepsy is a common chronic neurological disorder characterized by recurrent unprovoked seizures. Electroencephalogram (EEG) and intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings can provide essential clinical information for epilepsy diagnosis, seizure detection and classification. For seizure detection, the analysis of EEG/iEEG data in the frequency domain is one of the most widely adopted methods. Compared to previous works that focused on the analysis of single-channel EEG/iEEG signals, this paper introduces a multivariate spectral analysis approach, namely spectral envelope, to reveal the frequency patterns that contribute the most to seizure identification. The spectral envelope systematically selects the spectral components that appear simultaneously in multi-channel EEG/iEEG signals, thus enhancing the common periodic signatures. By computing the time-varying spectral envelopes, the dynamic spectral characteristics of multi-channel 1-d EEG/iEEG time series are represented by 2-d time-frequency diagrams, which serve as the inputs to the subsequent classifier. A deep CNN, VGG-16, which has been pre-trained on ImageNet image dataset, is employed. After slight modification in the structure, the VGG-16 network is transferred to the classification task. The above approach was evaluated by experiments conducted on the HUP dataset, a multi-channel iEEG dataset. Compared to single-channel iEEG signals analysis methods including short-time Fourier transform and continuous wavelet transform, the proposed approach better captures the spectral features of multi-channel iEEG signals. The results show the reliability of our method, with an average accuracy, precision, and sensitivity of 98.49%, 98.7%, and 97.91%, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile AdHoc Network Communication Technology in Large Urban Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The role of vehicle-to-vehicle communication in vehicle operation is very important, but there is a problem that the communication effect has certain limitations. Traditional research methods cannot solve the problem of vehicle-to-vehicle communication in vehicle operation, and the communication effect is poor. Therefore, this paper proposes an AdHoc network technology to analyze vehicle-to-vehicle communication in large urban environments. First, AdHoc routing is used to connect the communication between vehicles, and the indicators are divided according to the communication requirements between vehicles to reduce them Interference factors in vehicle-to-vehicle communication. Then, AdHoc routes vehicle-to-vehicle communication to the vehicle, forms a vehicle-to-vehicle communication scheme, and communicates the results between vehicles Conduct a comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, AdHoc network technology communicates between vehicles for vehicle operation The range and communication connection time between vehicles are better than traditional research methods.

articleTitle: Exploration of Agenda Setting for Short Video News Dissemination under Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Agenda setting plays an important role in short video news dissemination, but there is a problem of poor communication effect. Traditional algorithms cannot solve the problem of setting the agenda of short video news communication, and the video dissemination effect is poor. Therefore, this paper proposes an intelligent algorithm to study the agenda setting of short video news communication. Firstly, the short video news is analyzed through data analysis, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of agenda setting to reduce the influencing factors of agenda setting. Secondly, the agenda setting scheme is formed through intelligent algorithms, and the agenda setting scheme is comprehensively analyzed. The simulation results show that under the same verification criteria, the algorithm proposed in this paper can set the theory of mass media agenda and provide feasible ideas for short video news dissemination.

articleTitle: Ensembling of Deep Learning Models for Automatic Diagnosis of Breast Cancer with Histopathology Images
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Cancer-related deadly illnesses affect both developed and underdeveloped nations globally. For instance, the prevalence of breast cancer among women rises daily, partly due to ignorance and early-stage cancers not being recognized. So its early detection can help in decreasing this fatal disease. Employing computer aided diagnostic systems can help detect breast cancer at the initial level. In this research, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has been proposed for the automatic detection of Breast Cancer. Firstly, ResNet50v2 pretrained model has been used for the classification task. The model has shown satisfactory results with a training accuracy of 80.17% and a validation accuracy of 81.70%. Further, the model is simulated again with the implication of the proposed CNN model. The performance of this model shows great results with a training accuracy of 82.57% and a validation accuracy of 87.80%. The value of Roc-AUC is 0.82 for this CNN model which shows the efficacy of the CNN model in classifying the images into Benign & Malignant. This research can be further used in the Medical and healthcare fields.

articleTitle: Chatbot for Agriculture Commodities Price Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Agriculture is an essential sector, feeding the global population and driving economic growth. With the world’s population growing rapidly and the demand for food increasing, there is a need for innovative technologies to improve agricultural productivity and efficiency. Chat-based price recommendation is one such technology that revolutionizes the agricultural sector. In this study, we proposed a price recommendation system with text analytics in the Kannada language that will help farmers get the information easily. The system provides weekly price recommendations with where and when to sell the commodity to get a better price. We have considered districts of Karnataka and Tomato for this study.

articleTitle: Image Processing based Counter for Blood cells
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The amount of White Blood Cells and Red Blood Cells is crucial for any doctor in diagnosing various disorders, including anaemia, leukaemia, and other conditions. Therefore, accurate blood cell counting is crucial. Using a tool called a hemocytometer, the traditional procedures employed in hospital laboratories entail manually counting blood cells. However, this procedure is incredibly tedious, takes a long time, and produces unreliable results. The hardware alternatives are the Automated Haematology Counter, which is quite expensive and unaffordable in every hospital lab. This study provides an image processing method that uses thresholding and circular Hough transform to distinctly identify and count the quantity of red blood and white blood cells in the blood sample image. Detection and counting of blood cells on microscopic blood pictures of each subject resulted in an accuracy of 93.1

articleTitle: YOLO V7: Advancing Printed Circuit Board Defect Detection and the Quality Assurance
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The PCB serves as a critical component in the project’s electronic system, to achieve specific functionality. This paper introduces the YOLO v7 deep learning method for defect identification and quality inspection of circuit boards. This process is essential for identifying and rectifying defects that could compromise the functionality and reliability of electronic devices. Traditional methods fall short due to subjectivity and time constraints. YOLO v7’s real-time object detection prowess is harnessed to automate and enhance the process. A collection of circuit board datasets is annotated and preprocessed. YOLO v7 is fine-tuned on this data. Designing and implementing a computerized system that is capable of classification and identifying flaws in circuit boards is the primary objective of this study. This requires creating a powerful deep-learning model to analyze circuit board defect images accurately, localizing defects down to the pixel level, and bridging the gap between traditional inspection methods and modern demands.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Evaluation of High Gain Dual-Band Antenna for Wearable Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: A novel design of a high-gain, dual-band wearable antenna for Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) and WiMAX applications is presented. The proposed antenna operates at two frequency bands, 2.3885-2.51 GHz and 3.5030-3.5968 GHz with an overall dimension of 17 × 25 × 0.787 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The substrate used in the design is Rogers 3010 (RO3010) which has a relative permittivity (ε<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>) of 10.2 and loss tangent (tan δ) of 0.0035. The antenna is evaluated for parametric analysis, reflection coefficient, gain, and 2D/3D radiation plots to describe its performance. It maintains a high-gain of 11.28dB at 2.45GHz and 9.71dB at 3.5GHz. The antenna suggested in this study shows great potential for being utilized in wearable applications involving WLAN and WiMAX.

articleTitle: Design of Electric Power Intelligent Information Interaction System based on Text Similarity Measure
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The role of text similarity measurement in the design of power intelligent information interaction system is very important, but there is a problem of inaccurate result evaluation. The system design theory cannot solve the problem of text similarity measurement in the design of electric power intelligent information interactive system, and the evaluation is unreasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes a system design theory to analyze the measurement of text similarity. Firstly, the system design theory is used to evaluate the text, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of text similarity measurement and reduced Distractors in text similarity measures. Then, the text similarity measurement of power intelligence information is evaluated by system design theory, and the text similarity measurement scheme is formed, and the text similarity measurement is measured the results were comprehensively analyzed. UID simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, information interaction design theory has a strong impact on power intelligence information The accuracy of text similarity measurement and the measurement time of text similarity are better than the system design theory.

articleTitle: Low-Voltage Flip-Flop Operation with Transition Completion Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: A novel incredibly fast and very dependable D-flip-flop operation at low supply voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DD</inf>) is proposed using transition completion detection (D-FF-TCD). The D-FF-TCD uses internally produced signal detection to indicate when the D-FF stage changeover is finished. By gating the pull-down strategy of the DFF stage and inferior latch, the signal used to detect disappears the decrease in operational yield, current contention, and errors with prior D-FFs. The hold duration, operating yield, consumption of energy, speed, area of existence and projected FF’s are quantifiably evaluated for a broad scope of V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DD</inf> using the technology of 48-nm fin-FET. The D-FF-TCD's lowest VDD is demonstrated to be 570mV lower than that of earlier D-FFs, demonstrating that the D-FF-TCD can continue to drive while VDD is in the sub-threshold or near-threshold range. The D-FF-TCD functions twice as rapidly as the MSFF in terms of realistic hold time.

articleTitle: A 64 BIT MAC Unit Design based on FPGA Using Vedic Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The main design constraints of circuits in VLSI technology at the moment are size, electricity, and speed. The MAC is influenced by the multiplier's pace. With regular multipliers, the circuit design will operate more slowly and use more energy. The area is decreased by the recommended MAC unit by lowering the multiplier's addition and multiplication operations. The hierarchical structure of the Vedic multiplier unit allows the suggested model to operate at a faster rate. Therefore, performance of Mac may be improved by employing an effective Vedic multiplayer that has superior speed, strength, and area. These Sanskrit multipliers, which are based on Sanskrit science, are really mentioned as being among the most efficient and rapid force multipliers to expedite, Triyagbhayam, a branch of Vedic science, is used. The 64-bit MAC slows down all devices and slows down time. The MAC is created using Verilog code, and is then implemented on an FPGA board through Xilinx simulation and synthesis.

articleTitle: Cross-platform Mobile Web Development Framework with Data Interaction Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The role of framework and data interaction in the mobile web is important, but there is a problem of inaccurate outcome evaluation. The AJAX model does not solve the problem of framework and data interaction in the mobile web, and the evaluation is unreasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes a cross-platform way to analyze the interaction between mobile web framework and data. First, metadata is used to evaluate the framework and data, and indicators are divided according to the requirements of the framework and data interaction, which is reduced Interference factors in the framework's interaction with data. Then, the metadata interacts with the mobile web framework with the data, forms a framework and data interaction scheme, and performs the framework and data interaction results Comprehensive analysis. Adobe Edge Inspect simulation shows that the cross-platform approach is correct under certain evaluation criteria The framework and data interaction accuracy and framework and data interaction time of the mobile Web are better than the AJAX model.
