articleTitle: Financial Data Prediction based on Intelligent Support Vector Machine Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The role of regression model in financial data prediction is very important, but there is a problem of inaccurate prediction results. Ordinary methods cannot solve the regression model problem of financial data prediction, and the prediction results are unreasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes an intelligent support vector machine for regression model analysis. Firstly, the computer is used to classify the data twice, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of the regression model to reduce the regression model in the interfering factor. Then, the computer identifies the regression model, forms a regression model scheme, and performs on the regression model results Comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that the regression model RI intelligent support vector machine on ILQDQFLDO GDWD under certain evaluation criteria The calculation accuracy and calculation time are better than ordinary methods.

articleTitle: Modified Neural Style Transfer using the Chan-Vese segmentation and the Laplacian Image Pyramid
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In recent times, Neural Style Transfer has been a highly probed area of Machine learning. Style Transfer refers to the fashion of embedding the Style of one image onto another image while conserving its natural contents. As transferring the style of one image to the target image is an NP-hard problem, it is veritably delicate to achieve and largely computationally ferocious. Also, the Content and Style of an image are very idiomatic and hard to express in terms of fine equations. But with the help of the Gram Matrix, the insight into the style of an image is more or less expressed. The gram matrix is extracted from the feature maps taken from some formerly pre-trained models like VGG19, YoloV4 etc. The Total loss function is defined as a combination of the content loss function captured by the layers of the neural network and the style loss function is deduced from the attained Gram matrix. The basic idea of this paper is that the energy difference between the generated image and the original content image should not differ much because content must be preserved up to 70-80% or more, thus to lower the difference, the high-frequency content details are embedded in the generated image at every cycle or at some intervals. In this paper, the author has modified the process by introducing the high-frequency content details present at the minimal energy area of the content image so as to reduce the number of iterations required to converge and have better content details in the generated image as opposed to generic neural style transfer. The high-frequency component of the content image is derived from the Laplacian Image pyramid algorithm and the Chan-vese algorithm gives a lower energy area of the image segments.

Author Keywords: Peak Signal to the Noise Ratio

articleTitle: A Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Management using Blockchain and IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Counterfeit drugs pose a significant and increasingly urgent global problem, jeopardizing the health of consumers and the general population. As drugs pass through various stages in the supply chain, from suppliers to manufacturers to distributors and retailers, the original manufacturers lose track of how their products are used, while consumers remain unaware of the legitimacy of the drugs they receive. This issue leads to substantial economic losses for manufacturing companies and countries. Ensuring the verification of medicine authenticity and monitoring temperature conditions would enable medical professionals and patients to discard ineffective or expired medicines. This article suggests leveraging blockchain technology to combat drug counterfeiting and enhance traceability, security, and visibility in the pharmaceutical supply chain. An experimental system built on Ethereum was implemented and its cost-effectiveness was evaluated. The study utilized a virtual IoT device through the Cooja simulator to monitor the storage conditions of medicines.

articleTitle: Maximizing Crop Yields and Water Efficiency through Tailored Irrigation System Design and Crop Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Today various water-pump operating systems are available in the market, which allows the user/farmer to operate his water-pump from a distant location using mobile app or on a phone call to the system which is integrated with the water-pump. While studying the existing system we came across a problem that, existing systems does not provide any solution for optimizing the usage of water and power. Optimizing the use of power and water in farming has become a real-time problem these days. To overcome this problem, we have proposed an IOT based system "Advanced Irrigation System". This system provides automation for operating the water pump in the farm by automatically turning ON and OFF the water-pump depending on the type of the crop and its moisture requirements. Also, proposed system provides farmer interface via a mobile application in his regional language, where he can check the moisture, humidity and temperature of his farm. Along with this proposed system has a Google Assistant integrated, using which famer can operate the water-pump remotely over a voice command.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of a Blockchain based Ubiquitous Mobile Data Capture System
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Mobile devices are being used as sensors in several IoT networks as they are ubiquitous, and have the necessary technology to perform complex tasks. Nonetheless, these devices are often exposed to different types of malicious attacks, which compromise the integrity and confidentiality of the system. This paper analyses the performance of a blockchain based mobile application that can capture data readings from a digital meter and transfer it securely across a network. In the proposed solution, a mobile and a desktop application, as well as a local server was implemented in Java. The block chain encoding was performed by the mobile application and decoding by the local server. To analyse the performance of the system, parameters such as the number of blocks and the key length were varied and the time complexity, latency, throughput, decryption time, encryption time and likelihood of a brute force attack within the blockchain network was measured. The results obtained showed that the fewer the number of blocks, the lower the latency and the higher the throughput. However, the likelihood of a brute force attack within the system is greater when fewer blocks are used.

articleTitle: Efficient Cache Timing Attack on the Present Algorithm for Master Key Recovery
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Conventional side-channel attacks have limitations, like being inefficient, facing considerable challenges in gathering and injecting fault data in real-world scenarios, and having limited practicality. In recent years, a novel form of side-channel attack called the "cache timing attack" has emerged. This technique capitalizes on the disparities in the computer CPU cache’s reading speeds to allow attackers to access confidential information during algorithm execution. It offers high attack efficiency and comes with relatively low costs. The "Present" algorithm, introduced in 2007, is a lightweight block cipher with outstanding hardware implementation and a streamlined round function design. Researchers from both domestic and international backgrounds have explored various side-channel attack methods on this algorithm, including differential attacks, multiple differential chain attacks, and algebraic attacks. Remarkably, there has been no published research on applying the cache timing attack to the Present algorithm, either domestically or internationally. In this paper, we employ a combination of the cache timing attack and a side-channel Trojan horse to obtain the output values of the S-box during the initial and second rounds of the encryption process. Subsequently, we integrate this data with a key recovery algorithm to ultimately retrieve the algorithm’s master key. This research contributes to a better understanding of the vulnerabilities of the Present algorithm, with a focus on reducing similarity to existing texts.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Early Osteosarcoma Detection: A Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Cancer is a deadly disease, which is commonly seen in the persons. Osteosarcoma is also a form of cancer in bones. It is mostly found in legs and long bones. So it is very important in order to detect this disease correctly and then take proper diagnostics. By evaluating the diagnostic medical techniques such as X-ray scans, CT scans, the main aim is to accurately determine the diseased area in the bone tract. Due to noise and the lower number of slices per pixel in the scanned images, it is necessary to pre-process the images with a median filter in order to remove the noise. Here convolutional neural networks are also used in order to retrieve the images. The retrieved pictures are categorized and recorded using a CNN classifier in order to determine the stage of illness, which helps the clinician make treatment recommendations.

articleTitle: Multi-drone Task Allocation based on Adaptive Fireworks Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: At present, a kind of flight equipment commonly used by analysts can carry out various tasks and achieve good results. At present, the research method is mainly to plan GPS on microcomputer, but the planning effect is poor. Therefore, it is necessary to plan UAV by using intelligent algorithm. The algorithm proposed in this paper and the path optimization rate are about 10%, and the UAV is suitable for UAV analysis and path analysis in the whole response speed practice. The results of instinct research show that the intelligent algorithm can optimize relevant data and simplify the planning process of UAV.

articleTitle: Pneumonia Disease Classification Utilizing Artificial Intelligence on VGG19 Model using Chest Xray Images
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Pneumonia is a sickness that causes swelling in the sacs in your lungs that help you to breathe. It can affect one or both lungs. The small bags of air in the body might become filled with liquid or pus, which can make a person cough up mucus or pus, have a fever, feel cold, and have trouble breathing. Many different tiny things like bacteria, viruses, and fungi can give you pneumonia. Pneumonia can be mild or very dangerous. This is very risky for babies, young kids, elderly people, and those with health issues or weak immune systems. In this study on pneumonia illness, classification is carried out utilising VGG19 Model using chest X-ray pictures, with the aim of improving accuracy which proves out to be 93% accurate. This appears to be an important and promising use of artificial intelligence in the medical industry. The study also suggests ways to enhance the practises now used by the medical community. It's crucial to keep in mind that creating a classification model for pneumonia requires a combination of deep learning, medical imaging, and domain knowledge skills. To assure the model's clinical validity and safety, collaboration with medical specialists is necessary.

articleTitle: Enhancing Dining Experiences: Virtual Food Menu with Aroma Dispenser Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) is a game-changing force, in the evolving world of technology seamlessly blending the physical realms to enhance human experiences. A prime example of this convergence can be seen in the Virtual Food Menu (VFM) software explored in this research paper, which combines AR technology, multisensory interaction, and cuisine.By integrating augmented reality (AR) with tempting aromas the VFM app presents a groundbreaking approach that completely transforms the experience. This cutting-edge software offers users a captivating blend of stimuli immersive visual effects and the vivid power of scents through the utilization of Unity, Vuforia, and scent-emitting technologies.

articleTitle: Vehicle communication and Traffic analysis using LoRa Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Hal Varian predicts that in the coming decades, "the ability to take data—tobe able to understand it, to analyse it, to extract value from it, to visualise it, to convey it—is going to be an enormously significant skill." This paper presents a novel approach for enhancing vehicle communication and conducting traffic analysis using LoRa (Long Range) technology. As the number of vehicles on the roads continues to grow, effective traffic management and real-time communication among vehicles become crucial for ensuring safety and optimizing traffic flow. The proposed system leverages the low-power, long-range capabilities of LoRa to establish a reliable and wide-reaching communication network for vehicles. The system architecture includes LoRa-enabled onboard units (OBUs) installed in vehicles, which enable data exchange among neighboring vehicles and road infrastructure. Additionally, LoRa gateways are deployed across key locations, facilitating the collection and aggregation of vehicle data. The LoRa-based communication network enables seamless communication, even in remote and challenging terrains.To analyze traffic patterns, the paper presents a robust data analytics framework that processes and interprets the data gathered from the LoRa-enabled OBUs. Various traffic parameters, such as vehicle density, speed, and congestion levels, are monitored and analyzed in real-time to provide valuable insights to traffic management authorities and drivers. Moreover, the proposed system offers predictive capabilities to anticipate potential traffic bottlenecks and optimize traffic signal timings, thereby reducing overall congestion and enhancing road safety.Overall, this paper presents a comprehensive solution for vehicle communication and traffic analysis, leveraging the advantages of LoRa technology. The proposed system has the potential to revolutionize modern transportation systems by enabling seamless communication and data-driven traffic management, contributing to safer and more efficient road networks.

articleTitle: Exploring Data Stream Classification: Comparative Review of Single and Ensemble Classifier Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: With the increasing use of technology stream classification is important dynamic and changing nature. Data in the data stream comes at a very high speed thus it has to be taken care of in real-time. Due to its complex nature, certain problems can arise over time. To handle these problems better, the requirement for competent and effectual techniques has increased. Regular static data classification techniques cannot be used for classification in Data steam. This paper aims to explore different Learning algorithms that were proposed for successful classification in streaming data over the years. The paper describes single classifier and ensemble classifiers algorithms. The paper shows the streaming data classification research along with its comparison. We also reviewed and compared several elements of the previously presented potential algorithms. We have outlined other crucial aspects that each algorithm addresses.

articleTitle: Malaria Parasite Disease Classification using Deep Learning Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Malaria is a global health threat caused by the Plasmodium parasite. The early identification and classification of the parasite are vital for prompt treatment and improved patient outcomes. However, traditional detection methods depend heavily on expert knowledge for accurate diagnosis, making them challenging to implement. This paper aims to conduct a comprehensive analysis of 6 existing deep learning models including AlexNet, GoogleNet, VGG19, MobileNet, ResNet, and RCCNet utilizing the malaria parasite dataset. Additionally, we perform a comparative evaluation of these models by implementing various Data Augmentation techniques and improving accuracy by 3% reaching maximum accuracy up to 96.73 %. The assessment is centered around key factors such as training duration, precision, weighted f1 score, specificity, and sensitivity.

articleTitle: A Technique for Maintaining Attribute-based Privacy Implementing Blockchain and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Any wireless network is built on the mutually reinforcing pillars of privacy and security. Security measures often cover data connections, physical security, outside threats, and internal node operations. Whereas privacy covers the selective exchange of data among a network’s various entities. To provide privacy to networks, a large number of algorithms have been proposed by researchers in the past. Most of these algorithms utilize Graph-based anonymization approaches like l-diversity, k-anonymity, etc. These models do not scale well. Thus, this text proposes a machine learning-based block chain-powered privacy preservation protocol. The proposed protocol will perform attribute-based privacy with high efficiency due to the use of block chain architecture and will improve the overall Quality of Service of the network due to the integration of machine learning in the system.

articleTitle: A Computational Data Science Based Detection of Road Traffic Anomalies
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: An essential component of an Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) is anomaly detection. There is an increasing need for the identification of unusual occurrences in the traffic network due to the yearly growth in vehicle usage and the continual improvement of the traffic networking. Traffic anomaly detection provides sufficient decision-supporting information for road network operators, users, and other stakeholders. It is difficult to find anomalies in large-scale multivariate road traffic data. By bridging the gap between automated and manual traffic analysis methods, visual analytics helps increase process transparency. New rapid and effective processing tools and methodologies are required to swiftly extract and analyze data from the enormous volume of data. Data science approaches can be used to research and pinpoint various kinds of severe attacks and anomalies. Hence, Computational Data Science based detection of road traffic Anomalies is presented in this analysis. Thecomputational data science techniques (CDS) are needed to manage vast volumes of traffic data in a wide range of forms. Finding abnormalities in traffic data that impact traffic efficiency produced the development of computational data science.The primary advantage of the CDS approach is the early identification of data anomaly sources to avoid traffic congestion over a long-term.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Strategy for Detecting and Analyzing Fake Online Content
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Sensational and fake news are created and spread through social media to achieve the intended end. It may also involve narration of a true fact however being deliberately exaggerated.The idea of this research is to identify the authenticity of the news/information present on the web in the form of text, links and images. The main aim is to feed in some dynamic information and determine whether it’s real/misleading(fake). In this paper, we propose a novel model for our real-time application that detects fake news by examining the accuracy of some content, link or image given by the user, and predicting its authenticity based on a score.

articleTitle: Real Time Voice/Speech Command and Control System (CCS) for Unmanned Aerial and Ground Vehicles on 4G Cellular/GPRS Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Unmanned Autonomous systems are the vehicles/systems that operate without/less human interaction and carryout the operations by means of advanced electronic components as On-Board Computing technologies. Unmanned Autonomous systems are some of the most important applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and the development of such technologies promote innovations in Advanced Intelligent technologies. Examples of Unmanned Autonomous systems are- Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV’s), Unmanned Ground vehicles (UGVs) Unmanned Water Vehicles (UWV) those have made ground-breaking advancements in many real-world applications for societal needs. Some of the applications include from surveying to transportation to security surveillance etc. Most of the Unmanned Autonomous systems are operated through HCI (Human Computer Interface) like Ground Control Stations (GCS) or Joystick for commanding and controlling the vehicles via command is sent in the compatible format by which vehicles would understand for operations. However, a very less/no work is carried out to operate the vehicles through voice/speech and translate the same into the compatible format by which the system would understand. HCI technologies with speech/edge computing devices is increasing in operating the vehicles through voice/speech models running on the edge devices. However, the accuracy and real time performance of the interconnected devices plays a major role. In this paper, we propose to build one such system, operating on the edge computing devices for Unmanned Autonomous systems to operate through speech/voice commanding. In this paper, we present one such Autonomous unmanned system for operating UAV’s using Cellular (GPRS) communication, using Deep Learning system (LSTM) network running on Edge Computing devices, working with DroneKit with Speech based Commanding system. The system has an accuracy of 95.36% with Google Speech data augmented with custom data sets and the system has been tested in real time flights.

articleTitle: Comparison of Hate Speech Identification in Kannada Language Using ML and DL Models
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The problem at hand is to create a discrimination system specifically for Indian languages, with an emphasis on Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) implementations. Hate speech poses a serious challenge to online websites and social media, as well as causing harm, such as spreading hate, inciting violence, and promoting inequality. Macro skills are discriminatory, there is an urgent need for a similar system for regional languages as the country has many different languages and unique cultures. Therefore, this paper intends to gauge the overall performance of 4 characteristic engineering strategies and 4 gadget learning algorithms to examine their overall performance on a publicly-to-be-had dataset with two distinct classes. The experimental consequences confirmed that the bigram capabilities when used with the help vector machine set of rules great carried out with 88% accuracy in ML and 91% of accuracy in DL. This observation has practical implications and can be used as a basis for detecting automated hate speech messages. Moreover, the output of different affinity could be utilized as country-of-artwork strategies to compare destiny research for existing computerized text classification techniques.

articleTitle: Blockchain Unleashed: Exploring its Multifaceted Applications and the Dynamics of Proof-of-Work
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In a range of sectors, such as banking, healthcare, and the Internet of Things, we have seen several data security and confidentiality issues. So, it is revealed that blockchain can provide a solution to the security problem. Thanks to the distributed database technology known as a blockchain, a trusted third party are not required for secure and transparent transactions between parties. The integrity of the chain is ensured by the cryptographic hash of each block in the chain, which makes each one tamper-proof. Blockchain technology has the potential to revolutionize a wide range of industries, from finance to healthcare, by providing a secure, efficient, and transparent method of storing and transmitting data and value. After reading the research on blockchain applications in different fields, we will highlight some of the major advantages we understand

articleTitle: ResumAI: Revolutionizing Automated Resume Analysis and Recommendation with Multi-Model Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Finding and organizing suitable candidates for a vacant job position can pose challenges, especially when there is a high volume of submissions. This can impede team growth as it becomes challenging to identify the most suitable individual in a timely manner. To address this issue, an automated system called "Resume Recommendation and Classification" can expedite the selection process and aid in decision-making, while also reducing the time-consuming task of fair screening and shortlisting. This research utilizes Natural Language Processing to collect resumes and extract the necessary information. Subsequently, the resumes are ranked using BERT and TF-IDF word embeddings to obtain similarity scores. A classification model is then developed to categorize resumes based on job designations. To categorize the resumes, various techniques were employed, including Multinomial Naive Bayes, Linear Support Vector Classifiers, and k-NN Classifiers. These approaches enable the classification of resumes based on specific criteria.

articleTitle: Classification of Cervical Cancer using ResNet-50
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks as a part of deep learning is one of the best ways to get accurate results in terms of identification and classification of images in the medical field. In terms of public health, cervical cancer is a major issue and early detection and prevention can save lives. Pap smear tests are widely used for cervical cancer screening, where cells from the cervix are collected and examined for abnormal growth. However, accurately analyzing pap smear images can be challenging, and there is a need for automated methods for efficient and accurate diagnosis. In this study, we advocate a classification method for cervical cancer based on pap smear images using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with ResNet50 architecture and applied on the SIPAKMED pap-smear image dataset. The use of ResNet50 architecture in the CNN allows to improve the feature extraction as well as classification. The accuracy levels reached were 97.5%, making it a powerful tool in medical image analysis. The proposed scheme is compared with VGG 11 architecture accuracy of 92%.

articleTitle: Real Time Fall Detection Model with Action Recognition based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Healthcare practitioners are making great use of the benefits of most cutting-edge technologies, which is improving the area of healthcare on a scalable basis. The shift from manual to very accurate virtual monitoring has occurred. An important global concern is the care of the elderly. A fall is among the worst things that may happen to an aged person. With the ageing population expanding faster than ever, fall detection systems are essential. Fall detection and rescue systems may now quickly offer emergency assistance to victims of unintentional falls, thanks to advancements in technology. This makes it possible to provide appropriate care and lower the number of fatalities brought on by falls. We present a deep convolutional neural network based real-time fall detection model. Because it provides real-time monitoring and fall detection, an automated fall detection model is essential for elder care. Manual fall detection and timely intervention depend on several parameters being available in a timely manner. Real-time monitoring systems and deep learning approaches can be used to do this. Many deep learning networks can be used for fall detection. We present an effective approach using torch tensors and deep convolutional neural networks for real-time fall detection. From a collection of real-time input videos, the system will distinguish between fall and nonfall and respond accordingly. The user's actions and the fall will be recognized by the system. An automated fall detection system in hardware was demonstrated using an LSTM neural network model on an Up Extreme Series single-board computer. A summary of the experiments can be found in the appendix.

articleTitle: LoRA Communication Testing for LOS and NLOS Operations
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Communication plays a vital role in both connected and autonomous systems deployment, enabling important functions like data acquisition, monitoring for reliable, secure and safe operations. Selection of a communication method is driven by requirements like cost, reliability, performance, safety, security, and operating conditions. In this paper, the focus is on the communication options for distributed, outdoor robots under Line of Sight (LoS) and Non-Line of Sight (NLoS) conditions. Initially, details of various wireless networking options are compared and the rationale behind selection of Long Range (LoRa) communication is presented. Subsequently, the software and hardware factors within a communication architecture using LoRa are defined. Finally, implementation of LoRa-based communication architecture through successful results collected during tests simulating real-world LoS and NLoS operations is corroborated.

articleTitle: Secure Medical Data Transmission In Iot Healthcare: Hybrid Encryption, Post-Quantum Cryptography, And Deep Learning-Enhanced Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In the realm of IoT healthcare, safeguarding medical data is of paramount importance. This study introduces a comprehensive approach that combines hybrid encryption, post-quantum cryptography, and deep learning techniques for secure medical data transmission. The process begins with data transformation, where collected medical data is converted into binary form and categorized into odd and even positions. Following that, hybrid encryption is used, combining RSA and Two fish for the odd positions, and advanced post-quantum cryptography, specifically NTRU Encrypt, for the even bits. Key selection leverages a hybrid deep learning model, incorporating Bi-LSTM and CNN. The resulting ciphertexts from RSA-Twofish and NTRU Encrypt are merged using secure multiparty computation. In parallel, a region of non-interest extraction employs an optimized U-Net with an anchor box optimized through the Self-Improved Butterfly Optimization Algorithm (SI-BOA). Advanced lattice-based coding further secures the ciphertext, making data inference computationally infeasible. Hyperelliptic curve cryptography is utilized for watermark embedding into medical images to ensure data confidentiality and integrity. Image compression via High-Efficiency Video Coding (HEVC) minimizes storage requirements without compromising image quality. Secure cloud storage is employed, complemented by blockchain integration to enhance data integrity, auditability, and access control. At the receiving end, a reverse process is executed to retrieve and decrypt medical data securely. This multifaceted approach offers a robust solution for the IoT-based delivery of healthcare of secure medical data.

articleTitle: AR-Based Mobile Application for Object Detection for Interactive Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The paper describes the creation and assessment of an augmented reality (AR) application for Android that aims to improve young learners' first-grade educational experiences. The program uses augmented reality technology to build an engaging and dynamic learning environment that promotes better learning results. This research emphasizes how augmented reality (AR) applications have the potential to transform basic education. People frequently use augmented reality technology in their daily lives and at work, particularly for visual help. The Indian educational system uses traditional teaching and learning techniques with no technology integration, especially for younger students. But one crucial element in improving the effectiveness of teaching and learning is the adoption of new technology. In contrast to the conventional reading process, this paper primarily focuses on learning through real-world artificial visualization. In order to improve classroom learning through greater engagement and interactivity using elements of augmented reality, this study suggests a mobile application for augmented reality-based interactive learning for elementary students in the Indian educational system. A computer-generated image is superimposed on a user's vision of the real world using augmented reality technology to create a composite view. The primary intent of the application was to provide speech output to animal and bird illustrations from the NCERT English book. Additionally, it has the ability to recognize various household items. We enhance the use of AR technology in education rather than entertainment by targeting the particular book being used in most of the schools in India.

articleTitle: DTroz: Exploring Ensemble Learning Technique for Preventing Trojan Access in Oil and Gas Industry for Digital Information Transfer
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The oil and gas industry heavily depends on efficient operational procedures to ensure the safe extraction, refinement, and distribution of vital natural resources. The need of ensuring smart device security in the oil and gas industry cannot be overstated, particularly in light of the increasing cyber hazards such as Trojan attacks that pose a significant threat to industrial data. The preservation of data is crucial in order to provide well-informed decision-making and enhance operational efficiency within this particular business. Machine learning provides a proactive and adaptable approach to address the sophisticated detection requirements necessitated by the dynamic and expanding landscape of Trojan threats. This work offers an experimental investigation into the potential of the Ensemble Learning approach to enhance security in the oil and gas sector specifically for android-based equipment. The research places emphasis on achieving high ROC-AUC scores, which is a commonly used metric for evaluating the discriminatory power of a model in distinguishing between legitimate and harmful network behaviors. The present work has considerable promise in enhancing the security of the oil and gas industry via the use of machine learning-trained servers for communication purposes, enabling the differentiation between authorized and non-authenticated users. Ensemble Learning plays a crucial role in safeguarding the industry’s smart devices from Trojan assaults and ensuring the security of its important data. This article emphasizes the significance of cybersecurity within the oil and gas industry and proposes a pragmatic approach to mitigating risks, so ensuring the sector’s ability to withstand challenges in the digital age.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Efficientnet Algorithm For Prediction Of Cervical Spine Fracture
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Over 1.5 million spine fractures result in 17,730 spinal cord injuries yearly. The cervical spine is where fractures in the spine most frequently occur. Usually, fractures in the cervical spine are caused by car accidents, slips and falls, and conditions like osteoporosis. The majority of the fractures are caused by osteoporosis. Every year, 2 million broken bones in people of all ages occur due to this condition. A cervical spine fracture can cause paralysis, brain damage, and possibly death for the sufferer. A delay in a fracture diagnosis can have terrible repercussions, including worsening of neurologic function and even death. It is crucial to find vertebral fractures quickly. Computed tomography, multidetector computed tomography, magnetic resonance imaging, and other techniques can be used to diagnose spine injuries. The results of these Computed Topography and Multidetector Computed Topography Scans are more precise. We use a state-of-the-art technique to build a model using different Deep neural network algorithms, such as EfficinetNet, Vision Transformer, VGG, Inspection, MobileNet, and Densenet, which will be applied on CT and MDCT scans of patients with spinal cord fractures for foretelling and diagnosing the trauma, paralysis, or catastrophic decline in neurologic function with serious repercussions. The accuracy of the proposed EfficientNet model in evaluating the probability of a cervical spine fracture is 79%.

articleTitle: Medicinal plant classification using attention mechanism driven VGG19 and Resnet101
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The accurate classification of the medicinal plants is essential in various fields such as pharmaceutical research, traditional medicine, and biodiversity conservation. In this study, we focus on advancing the performance of two popular convolutional neural network architectures, VGG19-BN and Resnet101, for the classification of plant species which have medicinal properties. We propose the integration of attention mechanisms, specifically the Channel-wise Attention Module (CBAM) and the Efficient Channel Attention (ECANet), to improve the feature representation and discrimination capabilities of the models. By enhancing the attention to salient regions, the models become more adept at capturing intricate botanical attributes that contribute to accurate classification. Overall, this study contributes to the advancement of state-of-the-art methods for medicinal plant classification through the integration of attention mechanisms.

articleTitle: Diabetes Prediction With Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Millions of individuals worldwide suffer from diabetes, a long-term metabolic condition. To effectively control the condition and avoid complications, early diabetes prediction and diagnosis are extremely important. In the field of healthcare, machine learning algorithms have become potent tools that provide promising diabetes prediction solutions. The use of several machine learning algorithms for the prediction of diabetes is described in this abstract. The aim of this research is to compare the effectiveness of several machine learning methods for predicting diabetes using an extensive data set. The dataset includes a variety of clinical and demographic characteristics of people, such as age, BMI, glucose levels, family history, and other pertinent details. The machine learning techniques taken into account in this study include logistic regression, XGboost, ADAboost support vector machines, random forests, k-nearest neighbors, and artificial neural networks. Several measures, including accuracy, recall, F1-score, and precision were utilized to evaluate the models. Our findings demonstrated that the random forest method outperformed other models, reaching accuracy of 89.9%, a precision of 84.5%, a recall of 90.4%, and an F1-score of 87.3

articleTitle: A Logical Design of Internet of Things Assisted Digital Health Record Monitoring System using Deep Learning Principles
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Intelligent systems for monitoring health have been made possible by the IoT and the mental/physical health of an individual may be monitored using such a system. Determinants of numerous diseases, both physical and mental include tension, worry and high blood pressure. Problems associated with aging including anxiety, depression, stress and pressure require specialized care in this context. The prompt identification of health issues by monitoring of nervousness tension, stress, and heart rate is a key to avoiding irreversible harm. This will improve health outcomes; lessen the burden on caregivers, and save money. Find innovative technological answers for continuous monitoring of stress, anxiety, and blood pressure through the use of covert embedded sensors as well as deep learning methods. As a result of the suggested smart health monitoring system, health monitoring services may now be provided quickly, cheaply, and reliably from remote places, whereas this was not previously achievable with conventional health care systems. The implementation of a blockchain-based framework has increased the safety and privacy of patients' private information and reduced the likelihood of it being misused. Using Deep Learning and related technologies to evaluate health data for numerous goals has aided in the achievement of both preventative healthcare and fatality control. This has allowed for the early diagnosis of chronic illnesses, which was previously impossible. The combination of computing resources in the cloud and electronic storage has been introduced in order to render operations cheaper and instantaneously. This research provides a comprehensive overview of the state of health monitoring technology, including the most up-to-date developments and the most pressing problems.

articleTitle: Phishing Attack Detection using Collaborative Learning Approach at Dynamic Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The security of personal information belonging to users is a critical concern in the technological community. Fraudsters use a variety of methods to get access to victims' personal information, including their information such as PINs, credit card numbers, & bank account numbers. Various sectors are impacted daily by the abuse of user passwords. Phishing entices more individuals to divulge confidential information Forged websites and emails that mimic the originals are the hackers' tools of choice. There is a variety of anti-phishing learning techniques that employ various approaches to protect people against phishing. Using the proposed method, they may detect phishing at several levels in a dynamic environment. The Proposed process can check emails with embedded links to external websites for validity. There are two ways to look at it. Information on prominent websites is compared to content on well-known reputable sites to determine authenticity. The 2nd step is to examine the relationship quality between the 2 locations by observing when or not any given place increasingly depends on any associated websites. They used virtual passwords for logging into websites to guard against phishing attempts. The proposed model has attained an accuracy of 98.23%, sensitivity of 97.82%, Phishing detection rate of 98.23%, and Recall of 96.73%, which are more improved compared to existing technologies.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Bitcoin Blockchain: Exploring Trends and Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The implementation of blockchain technology has become prevalent across several businesses, although its initial design was primarily intended for cryptocurrencies. The preservation of security and integrity inside blockchain networks is of utmost importance, and the process of anomaly detection serves as a crucial component in the identification and mitigation of potential threats. This research study aims to examine the patterns within the Google BigQuery Bitcoin Blockchain Dataset and utilize unsupervised anomaly detection techniques to locate anomalies within the dataset. The analysis conducted provides valuable insights into the temporal patterns exhibited by significant components of blockchain technology, including Transactions, Blocks, and Output Satoshis. Following this, we proceed to assess the effectiveness of the LSTM and Isolation Forest methods in recognising anomalous instances. The results of this study offer a significant basis for improving the security of blockchain systems by implementing anomaly detection techniques.

articleTitle: Exploring Dynamic Features of EEG Signals with Slow Feature Analysis for Epileptic Seizure Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Epilepsy is one of the most common disorders of the nervous system. Epileptic seizures are transient brain dysfunctions caused by sudden abnormal discharges of neurons in the brain. With computer-aided diagnosis systems, neurologists may diagnose seizure stages in Electroencephalogram (EEG) recordings more accurately. For automatic seizure detection, feature extraction is an essential stage, which is performed by handcrafted features or learning them, often by a deep neural network. In this paper, to explore the dynamic features in EEG signals, Slow Feature Analysis (SFA), a multivariate statistical approach that has been developed for process monitoring, is introduced into EEG data analysis. Several latent variables that are slowly varying and mutually independent, known as slow features, are extracted from multi-channel EEG data. Then the T<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> statistic and the S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> statistic of a few slowest features are constructed. The series of those two statistics represent steady variations and temporal variations of the dominant slow features, respectively. Characteristics of the two series are fed into a classifier for seizure detection. To verify the role of the suggested dynamic features, the random forest algorithm is adopted as the classifier. The proposed approach is evaluated on a benchmark dataset, the CHB-MIT dataset. The results show that compared to the commonly used features in EEG analysis, the slow features represent the intrinsic characteristics of the trend of EEG signals more effectively. It is noteworthy that compared with several previous methods, ours exhibits superior performance, achieving an average accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity of 98.25%, 98.35% and 98.23%, respectively.

articleTitle: Image Segmentation Algorithms using Different Unet Mechanisms and it Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Pneumonia is a lung illness that affects the respiratory system. Both viruses and bacteria are capable of causing this condition. Affected individuals will have a more challenging time breathing and will likely experience some pain. If not treated immediately, it can be fatal. Hence, pneumonia needs to be detected as soon as possible. Patients with pneumonia typically exhibit fluid accumulation within the air sacs as well as inflammation of the alveoli. If you want to see what your lungs look like clearly and precisely, a CT scan of the chest is the way to go. A chest x-signal ray's strength can help a radiologist determine whether or not pneumonia is present. UNet, a deep learning approach, can be used to diagnose pneumonia and pinpoint its location and severity. In this article, we use the RSNA Pneumonia Detection Challenge dataset to develop a UNet model to generate bounding boxes and masks. A reduction path that reapplies two folds without 3x3 padding is a key component of the UNet design. For better viewing, all images have been scaled down to 128x128 and 224 X224 for VGNET pixels. The mask is now the same size as the head. Determine the optimum loss function for the UNet architecture on the dataset by comparing distribution-based and region-based approaches. Model accuracy was found to be enhanced by combining the weighted cross entropy loss function with the bone loss function and the IOU or Jaccard loss. Object detection in photos can make use of the UNet model shown here as part of a current research method.As a result, the number of epochs run against the model was limited.

articleTitle: Lightweight Blockchain-based Secuirity Protocol for Internet of Vehicle Things
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: The purpose of vehicular ad hoc networks (VANETs) is to make road travel more pleasant. VANETs' message-sharing capabilities contribute to improved traffic management, reduced congestion, and safer driving. However, VANETs' usefulness might be diminished by the spread of fraudulent or erroneous communications. To address the need for lightweight security requirements in IoVT communications, this study proposes the Blockchain-based Security Protocol for Interent of Vehicle Things (BSP-IOVT). The suggested security approach aims to do various things, including identifying malevolent nodes and detecting forged communications based on parameters like sender node reputation and the time and distance efficiency of messages. In addition, the RSU blockchain now has an incentive system designed to nudge RSUs toward more proactive lifestyle choices. Extensive simulations indicate that the suggested system outperforms state-of-the-art techniques for spotting fake messages and bad actors in a network. At the same time, it offers little protections for IoVT conversations.

articleTitle: Notepal - A Currency Detector Application for Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: Individuals with visual impairments encounter a range of challenges in their daily lives, with one significant hurdle being the identification of currency during financial transactions. While the process of recognizing money appears straightforward for the average person, it poses difficulties for those who are visually challenged. Distinguishing between currency notes of different denominations becomes intricate due to the similar paper size and texture. In response, "Notepal", an innovative mobile application has been developed and designed to address this issue effectively. "Notepal: Currency Detector App for Visually Impaired" serves as an invaluable tool for the visually impaired community, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to enhance their independence. By utilizing the power of the Random Forest Classifier, an ensemble machine learning technique, and harnessing the capabilities of the OpenCV library, the application accurately detects the denomination of currency notes. Additionally, the integration of Text-to-Speech conversion further enhances user experience by transforming written information into audible cues. This amalgamation of technologies, brought to life within the Android Studio environment, represents a significant step towards facilitating seamless financial interactions for individuals with visual impairments.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Electric Vehicles using Smart Charging with Battery Power Auto Cut-Off Facility
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: In this article, we propose a system that is built on processes for the purpose of planning and controlling the charging procedures for electric cars (EVs). Because of the constraints imposed by the electrical power distribution network and the absence of smart meter devices, charging electric vehicles have to be carried out in a technique that is well-balanced, taking into account previous experience, meteorological information derived from data mining, and modeling approaches. Additionally, it was determined that a mobile application would be developed to assist electric vehicle drivers with information exchange and user mobility. The total time required to charge a car might vary greatly depending on its battery level when it first landed into the central location. This renders it hard to schedule charging-related procedures, leading to less-than-optimal usage of the charging infrastructure. To aid Electric Car Sharing (ECS) operators, this article presents a smart charging (SC) strategy for making the most of charging stations. The suggested SC makes it easier to control charging durations by dynamically distributing powers to vehicles in accordance with the condition of their charge and the time at which the charge should be completed. Analyzing a situation that actually occurred in the world allowed for an evaluation of how useful the technique that was offered is. With these adjustments, we were able to maintain compliance with the restrictions of the grid without negatively impacting the driving experience of the people we were testing on. It is possible that the intelligent charging technique may be able to be enhanced even more as soon as manufacturers begin exchanging data about the battery, such as the charge level.

articleTitle: High Level Cloud Architecture for Automated Deployment System Using Terraform
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Conference on Information Technologies and Communications (GCITC)
abstract: This research paper discusses the adoption of this high-level cloud architecture for automated deployment utilizing Terraform offers numerous benefits. It facilitates infrastructure consistency across development, staging, and engenderment environments, minimizing configuration drift and minimizing the jeopardy of deployment errors. It enables organizations to truncate manual intervention and human errors by automating the provisioning and management of cloud resources. The architecture additionally promotes infrastructure versioning, sanctioning organizations to track and manage changes over time, rollback to anterior versions if needed, and ascertain compliance with regulatory requisites. Terraform may be used in a variety of ways, whether by a single user, a small team, or a whole organisation at scale. By using CloudFormation interface or the Service provided by AWS Catalogue, which adds an additional layer of command and control, you may undeviatingly access that resource.
